Text: 動いていないようだ

English.Text: Out of service...

Text: 登れるかな

English.Text: So we've gotta walk?

Text:
よゆ～よゆ～！
景色を楽しめばいいんだよ

English.Text: Ah, you'll be fine. Fresh air, nice view...!

Text: なんにもねえよ

English.Text: The view ain't all that.

Text: あるのは　ぶっ壊れた魔晄炉だけだ

English.Text: Not unless you enjoy starin' at ruined reactors.

Text: そっか　バレットはこのあたりに詳しいんだよね

English.Text: Right... You grew up around here, didn't you?

Text: さあ　行こうぜ

English.Text: Let's get a move on.

Text: マテリアは魔晄が固まったものだって知ってる？

English.Text:
Materia's, like...
super-condensed mako or something, right?

Text: ああ

English.Text: So?

Text:
つまり　魔晄炉があるってことは
マテリアも……

English.Text:
So...that means, wherever we find mako...
we'll find materia too!

Text: よっしゃ　はりきっていこー！

English.Text: Alright! Timeout's over, team! Let's go!

Text:
ユフィ　オレたちはもう仲間だ
勝手なマネすんなよ

English.Text: You know, Yuffie, when you're part of a team, you can't just do whatever you feel like.

Text: なんでも　許可が必要ってこと？

English.Text: What? So does that mean I gotta run everything by you first?

Text: そうだ

English.Text: Yep.

Text: あっそう　じゃあ　歌っていいですか？

English.Text: So that's the game... Fine. Permission to sing, sir?

Text: ああ？

English.Text: What?

Text: 背中かいて　いいですか？

English.Text: Permission to scratch my back, sir?

Text: 耳ほじって　いいですか？

English.Text: Permission to blow my nose, sir?

Text: あくびして　いいですか？

English.Text: Oh, so tired...

Text: ねえ　ねえいいですか！

English.Text: Whoops! Didn't get permission to yawn yet!

Text: ねえねえねえ　いいですか！

English.Text: Well? Do I get permission or not?

Text: うるせえー！　全部　ダメだ！

English.Text: Sure! You can do it while you're warmin' the bench!

Text: 横暴　おーぼー！

English.Text: That's an abuse of power! Tyrant! Tyrant!

Text: ティファ　よくこんな人と一緒に戦ってきたね

English.Text:
Tifa, tell me your secret.
How d'you put up with this jerkface?

Text: でも　いいところのほうが多いよ

English.Text: His good qualities outweigh the bad.

Text:
悪いところが４９で
良いところが５１みたいな？

English.Text:
Yeah? By how much?
Like, 51% good guy to 49% jerkface?

Text: もうすこし　差があるかな

English.Text: Maybe a little more than that.

Text: バツが４５で　マルが５５？

English.Text: So, what, like a...fifty-five, forty-five split?

Text: ああ……

English.Text: Close to.

Text: ティファよう……

English.Text: Not you too, Tifa...

Text: エアリス　大丈夫かな

English.Text: Think Aerith might need a break.

Text: ごめん　足重くて

English.Text: Sorry... My legs're killin' me.

Text: すこし休もう

English.Text: Let's rest here.

Text:
でも　急がないとマテリア……じゃなかった
黒マント　逃げちゃうよ

English.Text:
But if we stop now, the materia─
I mean the mystery men─might slip away!

Text: そうだ　アタシが先に行って偵察してきてあげる！

English.Text:
Hey, I know what to do!
I'll go on ahead, and scout the area for us!

Text:
みんなはあとから来なよ
じゃあ　あとで！

English.Text: You guys can catch up later. Well, see ya!

Text: あとで……じゃねえよ

English.Text: "Catch up later," my ass.

Text:
心配だから　私も行くね
バレット　なんだか様子が変だし

English.Text:
Think I'd better go keep an eye on them.
Barret's not himself right now, y'know?

Text: 頼む

English.Text: I know.

Text: 上で待ってるから　ゆっくり来てね

English.Text: Take your time, okay? No need to rush.

Text: うん　ありがとう

English.Text: Thanks. Will do.

Text: エアリス　どうだ

English.Text: You still holdin' up okay?

Text: ふしぎ　からだ　軽いの！

English.Text: Yeah, feelin' great, actually! Could do this all day!

Text: だれか～！　背中　押してる？

English.Text: It's like...it's like someone's pulling me up!

Text: 山に歓迎されたようだな

English.Text: You've become one with the mountain.

Text: そうなのか？

English.Text: Say what?

Text:
そっかあ！
やっほ～　よろしくね～！

English.Text:
Really? I did?
Hey, thanks for having me!

Text: レッド　適当なことを言うな

English.Text: The hell are you doin', Red?

Text:
初心者にありがちな現象だ
倒れたら　私が運ぼう

English.Text: Relax. It happens to all new climbers. If she passes out, I'll carry her.

Text: やっほ～！

English.Text: Let's go!

Text: はあ……

English.Text: Ugh...

Text: 最近の登山者は　マナーがなっとらん

English.Text: I tell ya, hikers these days ain't got no manners.

Text: 山の基本は　あいさつだろう

English.Text: Ya greet each other. It's proper!

Text: あんたたちは　ちゃんと話しかけてくれるんだな

English.Text: Well, I'll be. Finally, folks who've got some manners.

Text:
いやね　今日はいつになく登山客が多いんだが
誰もあいさつしてくれなくてね

English.Text: I don't get it. Tons of folks hikin' up the mountain today, and not a one of 'em so much as nodded my way.

Text:
具合が悪そうな黒マントの男たちがいたから
声をかけたんだが　無視されたよ

English.Text: Even tried calling out to a few sick-looking fellas all in black, and what'd I get? Silence.

Text: ったく　登山のマナーがなっとらんよ

English.Text:
...Hikers these days never learn
to greet each other or somethin'?

Text:
そういや　元気な女の子が
猛スピードで駆けぬけていったな

English.Text:
Ran into a sprightly little lady too.
Now she was in a real hurry.

Text: 彼女にも　無視されたよ

English.Text: Couldn't even say "Hello."

Text:
女の子を追いかけて
大柄な男とお嬢さんも走っていったよ

English.Text: Must've been tryin' to stay ahead of that angry-lookin' fella with the pretty gal.

Text: 山は助け合いが肝心なんだがなあ

English.Text: Mountain ain't no place to be runnin' races, I'll tell ya that.

Text: 神羅のヘリだ

English.Text: One of Shinra's.

Text: ユフィたち　だいじょうぶかな

English.Text: Uh-oh. Think the others are okay?

Text: 急ごう

English.Text: We'll see.

Text: ほら　さっさとおりて

English.Text: C'mon, out ya go...

Text: タークス……

English.Text: Again?

Text: あら　こんにちは

English.Text: Well! Look who it is!

Text: 俺たちを追ってきたのか

English.Text: You here to pick a fight?

Text: はい？　ちがうちがう

English.Text: What? Oh...no.

Text: こいつら　ジュノンで迷子になってたんだよね

English.Text: Just dropping off some unruly passengers.

Text:
回収して運んでたら　急に騒ぎだしてさ
だから　おろすことにしただけ

English.Text:
They were fine when we left Junon...
and then they weren't...so, here we are.

Text: どうして突然騒ぎだしたのか　不思議だったけど

English.Text:
Dunno why.
One minute they were okay, and the next...

Text:
まいっか　考えるのは
わたしの仕事じゃないし

English.Text: Eh, whatever. This is way above my pay grade.

Text: じゃあ　もう帰る？

English.Text: So...that's it?

Text: わたしと先輩は　ね

English.Text: Well, since you're here...

Text:
わたしが相手してあげたいけど
あいにく忙しくて

English.Text:
We'd love to stay and chat,
but Rude and I are busy people.

Text: だから　今日はコイツで我慢してね

English.Text: She'll be more than happy to keep you company, though!

Text: 次はリベンジだぞ　と

English.Text: Now play nice, shitbirds.

Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Ready!?

Text: トドメだ

English.Text: You're done!

Text: やったね！

English.Text: What a team!

Text: タークス　やっぱり動いてる

English.Text: Guess the Turks're back on duty, huh?

Text: 迷惑な働き者だ

English.Text: Wish they'd all go on vacation.

Text: ねえ～

English.Text: For real.

Text: 急ごう　バレットたちが待っている

English.Text: Come on. We need to find the others.

Text:
続いて『ヒュージマテリアプロジェクト』の
話をしよう

English.Text:
The next order of business is
the Magnus Materia Project.

Text:
各地の魔晄炉で　同時多発的に
異常なエネルギー反応が検知された

English.Text: As you are aware, simultaneous energy spikes were detected in mako reactors across the world.

Text: 各データを詳細に分析したところ

English.Text: After analyzing the data from each site...

Text:
巨大な生命体が存在する可能性が
極めて高いという結論に達した

English.Text: we found the spikes stemmed from the arrival of visitors─unfathomably large life-forms.

Text: 我が愛しのウェポン

English.Text: Is that...a Weapon?

Text: 古い記録に　その名を確認した

English.Text: Based on available information, it would seem so.

Text: 星に危険が訪れると出現する怪物だ

English.Text: They supposedly appear when the planet is in danger.

Text: 体内に巨大なマテリアを内包する

English.Text: And each one carries an enormous orb of materia.

Text: いや　巨大なマテリアが生体化したと言うべきか

English.Text:
More specifically,
an orb from which they themselves were born.

Text:
その存在を知って以来　恋こがれ探し求めた
まさに　星と生命の神秘

English.Text: They are living enigmas─organisms dying to be understood, and finally my dream of capturing one is within reach!

Text:
この手で撫で　組織のヒダの奥まで調べつくしたい
この科学の目で！

English.Text:
Oh, what I wouldn't give to peel one's flesh back,
pull it apart...and see what makes it tick!

Text: 今回のプロジェクトで　その夢も叶う

English.Text: Your wish, Professor, will soon be granted.

Text: ヒュージマテリアを　この手につかむのだからな

English.Text: We'll all get what we want once that materia is ours.

Text: 納得できないわ

English.Text: This is ridiculous.

Text:
ヒュージマテリアの人工生成技術は
あとすこしで　実用化できるのよ

English.Text: Why waste time monster hunting when we're on the brink of creating the materia ourselves?

Text: もちろん　それは知っている

English.Text: I am aware of your efforts.

Text:
このプロジェクトは　あくまでも
天然モノの回収が目的だ

English.Text:
But it would behoove us to obtain
naturally occurring specimens as well.

Text: ビルのロビーにでも飾りますかな？

English.Text: Well, they would look good in the lobby!

Text:
マテリアなんぞどうでもいいが
抜け殻のほうは　私が引き取るぞ

English.Text:
Put them in the bathroom for all I care.
Just leave me the carcasses─those I'll take.

Text: ねえ社長　本当のことを教えて

English.Text: Mr. President, please. What is this really about?

Text: ウータイが狙っている

English.Text: Wutai is after them.

Text: それを先に言ってくれなくちゃ

English.Text: Well, talk about burying the lede.

Text: ハイデッカー　軍を借りるわね

English.Text: Heidegger. I'll need troops.

Text: 精鋭を用意してやろう

English.Text: My finest for the madam director.

Text: ルーファウス社長

English.Text: Mister President!

Text: なんだ？

English.Text: Yes?

Text:
プレジデントには
お答えいただけなかった質問があります

English.Text:
There's a question I never had the chance
to ask your father.

Text: 同じ質問をしてもよろしいですか？

English.Text: Perhaps you could speak on his behalf?

Text:
アバランチの活動に乗じた　魔晄炉の爆破
続く七番街プレートとスラムの破壊

English.Text: We used Avalanche's activities as a cover to sabotage our own reactors and destroy Sector 7.

Text:
ともにプレジデントは　ネオ・ミッドガル計画の
一部だとおっしゃっていました

English.Text: Your father assured us these acts were in service to the Neo Midgar Project.

Text:
しかし　実際にはネオ・ミッドガル計画の根幹をなす
約束の地は見つかっておらず　正体さえ──

English.Text: However, the fact remains that we have yet to locate the "promised land" of legend, or even confirm if it actually exists.

Text: オヤジは歳をとった　そしてあせった

English.Text: Great though he was, my father was old.

Text: あの暴挙の理由は　それ以外にないだろう

English.Text: And in his dotage, he became rash.

Text:
いい機会だ　あの件に関しては
私も疑問に思っていたことがある

English.Text:
But while we're on the subject,
there's something I've been meaning to ask all of you regarding those decisions.

Text: なぜ誰も　オヤジの凶行を止めなかった？

English.Text: Why is it that none of you even tried to stop him?

Text:
私は　神羅カンパニーを変えたい
より高く　深く

English.Text: Shinra must change. We must break new ground─grow stronger. Smarter...

Text: 広く　速く　強く　堅く

English.Text: Observe. Adapt. Expand. Control.

Text:
オヤジとともに戦ってきた君らには
おおいに期待している

English.Text: My father built his empire with your loyal support. And I demand the same.

Text: 私には　オヤジに見せた以上の忠誠を見せてくれ

English.Text: I expect you all to prove that you are devoted not only to the company, but to me.

Text: エアリス

English.Text: Aerith.

Text: ミッドガルって　どっちかな

English.Text: Hey, which way do you think Midgar is?

Text: 方角的には　東だ

English.Text: It would be east of here.

Text: 向こうだな

English.Text: That way.

Text: お母さん　元気かな

English.Text: I wonder how my mom's doing back there.

Text:
俺が会った時は　元気だった
心配してたけどな

English.Text:
She seemed fine when I saw her.
Maybe a little worried.

Text: 親不孝だね　わたし

English.Text: She's gonna hate me for this.

Text: 事情を話せば　わかってくれるさ

English.Text:
Talk to her as soon as you get home.
She'll understand.

Text: 説明　たいへんそう

English.Text: Really looking forward to that conversation.

Text: おまたせ！

English.Text: Sorry we're late!

Text: こっち　こっち～！

English.Text: Over here!

Text: 大丈夫？

English.Text: You okay?

Text: うん　いい汗かいた

English.Text: Yup! Really worked up a sweat!

Text: 偵察はどうだった？

English.Text: So how'd recon go?

Text:
異状ナシ！
ついでにマテリアも……ナシ

English.Text: All clear! No nasty surprises. And...no materia.

Text: 魔晄炉に着くまえに　とっつかまえたからな

English.Text:
We managed to catch her before
she could get as far as the reactor.

Text:
はやく魔晄炉へ行こう！
黒マントたちは　もう魔晄炉に行っちゃってるよ

English.Text:
Which is the whole reason we're here! So hurry it up
or those hooded guys'll beat us to it!

Text: わお～！

English.Text: Whoa...

Text: あれが……

English.Text: That's it.

Text: コレル魔晄炉だ

English.Text: The Corel reactor.

Text: あの黒マントの人たちって　なんなの？

English.Text:
Hey...so, what's the deal with all these
creepy hooded guys anyway?

Text: 神羅の犠牲者だ

English.Text: They're Shinra's victims.

Text: へえ　じゃあ　アタシたちウータイと一緒だ

English.Text:
Huh...
Well, they're in good company, I'll give 'em that.

Text: どういうこと？

English.Text: How you figure?

Text: ウータイはね　神羅にあちこち爆撃されて

English.Text:
When Shinra invaded Wutai,
it was...pretty bad.

Text: 街も　みんなもボロボロにされて

English.Text: They leveled towns, killed thousands.

Text: そのうえ　インチキな条約を押しつけられたんだ

English.Text:
And when the dust settled,
they forced some B.S. truce on us.

Text: 停戦は　ウータイも歓迎したんだろ

English.Text: I thought both sides wanted a cease-fire.

Text: ジジイたちが　勝手に受け入れたんだ

English.Text: The old geezers at the top did, yeah...

Text:
昔から国のことをぜんぶ決めてて
みんな　おとなしく従ってきたけど

English.Text: but the rest of us were pissed! They'd been running Wutai into the ground for years...

Text: こればっかりは　不満爆発！

English.Text: It was the last straw─we were done!

Text:
そんな　怒った国民が期待したのが
グレン大佐とその仲間たち

English.Text: Everyone was ready to kick those old farts to the curb. And that's when Colonel Lodbrok's team showed up...

Text: 元ソルジャーで脱走兵の三羽ガラス

English.Text: Three ex-SOLDIERs, ready to join the cause!

Text: 初耳だ

English.Text: Who'd you say?

Text:
さびついた　足枷みたいなしきたりをぶっ壊して
ウータイを元気にしてくれたんだ

English.Text:
Lodbrok! His squad saved Wutai from those
senile old fossils─paved the way forward!

Text:
そこに　大佐たちが信頼する
スフール総督って人が合流して

English.Text: They didn't do it alone, though. While the colonel's crew was rallyin' the people, their friend Viceroy Sarruf agreed to help.

Text:
革命が起きたってわけ
で　暫定政府が誕生したの

English.Text: Then bam! Revolution. And that is how the interim government was born.

Text: 革命か　やるじゃねえか

English.Text: Revolution, huh? Y'all did good!

Text: どうして　暫定政府なの？

English.Text: But...why the "interim"?

Text:
本当の政府は　神羅との戦いが終わってから
国民全員で選ぶものだからって

English.Text: Because...once this war with Shinra's behind us, the whole country's gonna come together and decide what kinda government we want.

Text:
だからね　アタシたちは
暫定が取れるように　がんばってるわけ

English.Text: Which is why we're doing everything we can to make sure the interim ends in independence.

Text: 燃えるっしょ？

English.Text: Pretty cool, right!?

Text: シュシュシュ！

English.Text: Sih, sih, hah!

Text: どーしたの　置いてくよ！

English.Text: Just gonna stand there? Let's get goin'!

Text: ほら　きてきて！

English.Text: Hey, come look at this!

Text: ねえねえ　これ　ぜんぶ魔晄なの？

English.Text: So, like, all that stuff down there is mako?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yup.

Text:
じゃあ　ここには
すんごいマテリアがあるんじゃない？

English.Text: Then it's gotta be hiding some ginormous materia!

Text:
どっひゃ～って
びっくりするようなマテリア！

English.Text: Woohoo! Oh, I'm gonna be so powerful it's scary!

Text: なになに！

English.Text: What's that!?

Text: どっひゃ～！

English.Text: Whoa!

Text: いまの　なんだ？

English.Text: The hell was that thing?

Text: ウェポンだ

English.Text: A Weapon.

Text:
星の守護者……
星に危機が訪れると出現すると言われている

English.Text: Tutelary creatures said only to appear when the planet is in grave danger.

Text: 宝条の憧れのひとつだ

English.Text: Hojo has sought them for years.

Text: ねえねえ　見た？

English.Text: Did you see what was inside it!?

Text: 体の中に　すんごくでっかいマテリアあったよね！

English.Text: That had to've been the biggest freakin' materia ever!

Text: なんとかして　捕まえらんないかな～？

English.Text:
Just gotta figure out how to catch
that overgrown fish.

Text: 星の守護者を捕まえる？

English.Text: That guardian of the planet?

Text:
あんなおっきなマテリア　欲しくない？
あれ　ぜーんぶアタシのものだよ

English.Text:
Whatever! I'm not about to let a materia that beautiful get away! And just so we're clear,
it's mine─I called it!

Text:
じゃあ　ここでゆっくり考えろ
俺たちは先に行く

English.Text: Cool. You fish. We'll keep moving.

Text: その言いかた！

English.Text: Hey! Not cool!

Text:
また来るよ　ウェポンちゃん
それまで元気でね！

English.Text:
This isn't goodbye, sweet Weapon!
I'll be back for you soon!

Text:
ウェポンってのが現れるほど
神羅が星を追い込んだってことだよな

English.Text: A "guardian beast" like that wouldn't show up unless Shinra had really pushed the planet to the edge.

Text:
つまり　アバランチの主張は正しかったってわけだ
なあ　そうだろ？

English.Text: Meaning...Avalanche was right about the threat they posed all along. We were, weren't we?

Text: ああ　でも危機の原因は神羅だけじゃない

English.Text: Yeah. But don't forget: Shinra's not the only problem.

Text: セフィロス　だね

English.Text: Right. Sephiroth is still out there.

Text: 行こう　星を助けないと

English.Text: He is. And talking won't stop him.

Text: どうなってるの？

English.Text: Ugh. Dead end?

Text: 跳ね橋だ　さげないと渡れない

English.Text: For now. Can't cross till we lower it.

Text: どうしよう？

English.Text: Well, this sucks.

Text: なんだよ

English.Text: What?

Text: バレット　なにか知ってる？

English.Text: You know this area...don't you?

Text: あそこにある操作室で　橋をおろせる

English.Text: Control room's up there, at the top of the cliff.

Text: どうやって行くの？

English.Text: How do we reach it?

Text: 炭坑を通る

English.Text: Through the mine.

Text:
長いことほったらかしだから
中がどうなってるか　わからねえ

English.Text:
Won't be a walk in the park though.
Place's been abandoned for years.

Text: 橋さげてやっから　ちょっと待ってろ！

English.Text: We're workin' on it! Just wait a minute!

Text: おい！

English.Text: Hey!

Text: クラウド！

English.Text: Cloud?

Text:
魔晄の影響かもしれない
しばらく休んだほうがいい

English.Text:
Perhaps the mako got to him.
Regardless, he's clearly tired.

Text:
クラウドは休ませて
アタシたちで橋をおろしに行かない？

English.Text: Cloud could rest here while a couple of us go and lower the bridge, yeah?

Text: そうだね

English.Text: Works for me.

Text:
そいつで連絡するからよ
それまで　ゆっくり休んでろ

English.Text: When that thing rings, you'll know we're done. And you don't move till you're good and ready.

Text: よし　そんじゃあ　しゅっぱーつ！

English.Text: Alright, put on your minin' helmets and follow me!

Text: すこし休めば回復すると思う

English.Text: I'll be okay. Just gimme a minute.

Text: クラウドはまかせて

English.Text: You go. We got him.

Text:
黒マントの連中は川を泳ぐつもりらしい
我々は無茶をせず　橋を渡ろう

English.Text: Our black-clad friends mean to swim across the river, but I see no reason not to use the bridge.

Text: え～っと　どっち？

English.Text: Uh... Which way?

Text:
あれで　上にいけるんだが……
電源を入れないと動かねえ

English.Text:
Up─with that thing.
But we're gonna have to power it on first.

Text: 電源は　あそこだ

English.Text: The generator's just across the way.

Text: あれを使え　飛び跳ねんのは得意だろ

English.Text: Gotta use that grappling hook. Shouldn't be a problem for you, right?

Text: ふふん　出番だね！

English.Text: Hehe, none at all.

Text:
上の階にある制御装置で
ロック解除しねえと　動かねえ

English.Text: Gonna need someone to unlock this thing from the control unit upstairs.

Text: 頼める？

English.Text: Can you?

Text: しかたないなあ～

English.Text: If I have to...

Text: 行けそう？

English.Text: You got this?

Text: よゆ～よゆ～！

English.Text: You even have to ask?

Text: またか～

English.Text: Not again...

Text: 人づかいが荒いなあ

English.Text: Why do I gotta do all the work?

Text: ピピピピピピ！

English.Text: Cheep cheep cheep!

Text: あっ！

English.Text: Wha...?

Text: ピピピピピピ！

English.Text: Peep peep peep!

Text: 助けないと！

English.Text: We have to help them!

Text: こんにゃろ～！

English.Text: Way ahead of ya!

Text: ほら　アタシたちが相手だよ！

English.Text: Hey! Over here, birdbrain!

Text: 大丈夫？

English.Text: You good?

Text: よゆー！

English.Text: Oh yeah!

Text: 竜巻で強くなっちゃった？

English.Text: Oh, it's on now, bird!

Text: ピピピピピピ！

English.Text: Peep peep peep!

Text: 飛んだ！

English.Text: Look at him go!

Text: おいで～！

English.Text: C'mere!

Text: あれ……？

English.Text: Or...not?

Text: やめろって！

English.Text: Leave me alone! Hey!

Text: 気に入られちゃったね

English.Text: Someone has a fan!

Text: バレット　ずるい！

English.Text: Aw, no fair!

Text: 仕方ねえ　連れてくか

English.Text: Got enough hangers-on already, but...fine.

Text: 見て見て　この子

English.Text: Hey, hey, check out its head!

Text: なんか　クラウドに似てない？

English.Text: Does it remind you of anyone!?

Text: うん　わかる

English.Text: It's Cloud, only cute!

Text: よし　キミの名前は『クラピヨ』だ！

English.Text: That settles it! I hereby dub thee, Cloud Jr.!

Text: ピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Text: 帰りはあれに乗って　いっきに山をおりようぜ

English.Text:
Hey, we could take that minecart down─
save ourselves a hike.

Text:
かなり揺れるが　楽で早いぜ
昔　ダインと――

English.Text:
Not the smoothest ride, but it sure is fast.
Me and Dyne used to...

Text:
いや　なんでもねえ
さっさと橋をおろしちまおうぜ

English.Text:
Forget it. Let's just lower the bridge and
get back to the others.

Text: これで　橋がおろせるんだよね？

English.Text: Okay! One of these buttons oughta do it.

Text: え～っと　どれどれ

English.Text: But...which one? Hmm...

Text: かわれ

English.Text: I got this.

Text: やったね！

English.Text: They did it!

Text: ああ

English.Text: Nice.

Text:
よし　いいだろう
クラウドたちに連絡だ

English.Text:
Right. Now that the bridge is good to go,
let's touch base with the others.

Text:
もしも～し　こちらユフィ
そちらはクラウドですか～？

English.Text:
Hello, hello! This is Special Agent Yuffie!
Can you read me, Commander Cloud?

Text: 体調はどう　なおった？

English.Text: How you doin'? Feelin' better?

Text: 問題ない

English.Text: I'm good.

Text:
オレたちは　トロッコでおりるからよ
おまえたちは線路を歩いてこい

English.Text: We'll take a cart back down. You three follow the tracks till you hit the bridge into town.

Text: 途中に吊り橋があるから　そこで落ちあおうぜ

English.Text:
Figure we link up there before heading in.
You copy?

Text: わかった

English.Text: Copy.

Text: ついでに　ルートの確認を頼む

English.Text: Oh, and set our route while you're at it, will ya?

Text:
ビビってるヤツがいるんで
なるべく　ぬるいルートを選んでくれ

English.Text:
The gentler the ride, the better.
Don't want anyone losin' their lunch.

Text: 頼むよ～　クラウド

English.Text: I'm beggin' ya, Cloud. Please!

Text: オレは　スリリングなのが好みだけどな

English.Text:
I wouldn't mind some excitement,
but whatcha gonna do?

Text: これで線路を切り替えるらしい

English.Text: We should be able to switch the track here.

Text:
線路　かなり古いけど
バレットたち　大丈夫かな

English.Text:
Do you think the others're gonna be okay?
These tracks seem about ready to fall apart.

Text: よほどのことがなければ　崩れない

English.Text: I have a feeling they'll hold for a while yet.

Text: わかるのか

English.Text: You do?

Text: ああ　さわれば大体な

English.Text: Of course. I'm standing on them, aren't I?

Text: あっ　知ってる！

English.Text: Wait, I've read about this!

Text:
イヌやネコ　足の裏で
色々わかっちゃうんだよね　それとおなじ？

English.Text: Cats and dogs can sense all kinds of stuff through their paws─things our feet could never pick up on.

Text: なんだっけ……あっ　にくきゅう！

English.Text: Yeah! They're super sensitive, your pads, right?

Text: 私のは　比較にならないほど高性能だ

English.Text: Except that mine can discern far more than any pet.

Text: ねえ　レッド

English.Text: So, Red...

Text: 断る

English.Text: No.

Text: なにも　言ってませんけど

English.Text: I didn't even say anything yet.

Text: 嫌な予感がした

English.Text: You didn't have to.

Text: さわらせて？

English.Text: One squeeze?

Text: ダメだ

English.Text: No.

Text:
お願い　ねえ
クラウドもさわりたいよね

English.Text: Please? If not for me, at least for Cloud?

Text: 興味は……ある

English.Text: I mean, I am kinda curious...

Text: グルルルルル……

English.Text: Grr...

Text: 宿に着いたら　マッサージしてあげる！

English.Text:
How 'bout this?
At the next inn, we treat you to a foot massage!

Text: グルルルルル！

English.Text: Grr...!

Text:
ここ　合流地点だね
ユフィたちに連絡しよ

English.Text:
This looks like the spot.
Let's call 'em up, tell 'em we're here.

Text: クラウド　線路はどうだった？

English.Text: Cloud! What's our route lookin' like?

Text: できる限りのことはやった

English.Text: Did what I could. Should be fine.

Text: ほんと？　揺れない？

English.Text: Are you sure? Like, really sure?

Text: ありがとよ　すぐに合流するぜ

English.Text: Thanks for that. Sit tight; we'll be down soon.

Text: そんじゃあ　トロッコで大冒険といくか

English.Text: Only way out is through, so buckle up, buttercup.

Text: だいじょーぶ　ゆれない　ユレない……

English.Text: It's fine... It's just a cart! It can't kill you!

Text: しゃあねえな

English.Text: Alright, Junior. In ya go...

Text: 行くぞ　振り落とされんなよ！

English.Text: Hold on, now─and I mean tight.

Text: いっけぇ～～～！

English.Text: I'm too young to die!

Text: ピピピピピピ！

English.Text: Cheep cheep cheep!

Text: クラウド　話がちが～う！

English.Text: I hate you, Cloud!

Text: クラウドのバカやろ～！

English.Text: You're dead, you spiky-haired l─agh!

Text: 大丈夫？

English.Text: You okay?

Text:
うん　思っていたよりはへーき
クラウド　ちゃんと線路を点検してくれたみたい

English.Text: Uh... Better than I thought, actually... Guess Cloud didn't feel like completely screwing us over.

Text: 物足りねえ

English.Text: Hmph, what a letdown.

Text:
ぐわんぐわんする
クラウド　許すまじ……

English.Text:
I'm seein' stars...
Cloud...you're so gonna pay for this...

Text: いいじゃねえか

English.Text: Give the man a break.

Text: クラウド　いい仕事ぶりだったぜ

English.Text: I think it was a memorable experience.

Text: 無事だったようだな

English.Text: Still alive?

Text: おかげさまで～

English.Text: Miraculously, yeah...

Text: ピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Text: かわいい！

English.Text: Who's this!?

Text: 助けたら　ついてきちゃった

English.Text: Think of him as a tagalong.

Text: あれ～？

English.Text: Wait a sec...

Text: ツンツン……

English.Text: That is...

Text: ツンツン！

English.Text: uncanny.

Text: そっくりでしょ　クラピヨっていうんだよ

English.Text: I know, right!? Meet "Cloud Jr."

Text: よろしく　ね

English.Text: Welcome aboard, Junior.

Text: ピヨ　ピヨヨヨ！

English.Text: Cheep cheep!

Text: やめてくれ

English.Text: Kill me.

Text: ピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Text: ピヨ！

English.Text: Cheep!

Text: あ～あ　行っちゃった

English.Text: Didn't even get to say goodbye...

Text: 家族は　いっしょがいちばんだ

English.Text: At least we know he's with family now.

Text: 元気でね　クラピヨ！

English.Text: We'll miss you, Cloud Jr.!

Text: 行くぞ

English.Text: C'mon.

Text: 気が進まねえぜ

English.Text: I am not lookin' forward to this.

Text: 地元らしいな

English.Text: Your homecoming?

Text: まあな……

English.Text: You'll see.

Text: おっと　誰かと思えば

English.Text: Well...look who it is.

Text: また　バレット様にお会いできるとはね

English.Text:
The great Sir Wallace has graced us
with his presence.

Text: どのツラさげて　戻ってきたんだ？

English.Text:
Surprised ya had the balls to come back.
But we're so glad ya did.

Text: ほ～ら　歓迎してやるぜ

English.Text: There. A hero's welcome.

Text: なにすんの！

English.Text: Leave him alone!

Text: いいんだ

English.Text: Don't.

Text: でも！

English.Text: What!?

Text: 行くぞ

English.Text: Let's go.

Text:
お嬢ちゃんたち
そいつについてくと死んじゃうよ

English.Text: Word to the wise! Stay far away from that asshole.

Text: 黒マント　いねえなあ

English.Text: Now where'd our buddies in black get to?

Text: ああ　酒がなくなっちまった

English.Text: Which of you dicks killed the bottle?

Text: おまえ　買ってこい

English.Text: Him. Go get more.

Text: ああ？　おまえが行けよ

English.Text: The hell I did. Get it yourself.

Text: そんな金　どこにあんだよ

English.Text: With what money, you shit-for-brains?

Text: バレットなんかにやるんじゃなかったぜ

English.Text: Why'd we have to go and waste it on Barret...

Text: 配給で　酒も出してくんねえかな

English.Text: You think we can get 'em to give us liquor rations?

Text: シロン先生に言ってみるか

English.Text: May as well ask the doc.

Text: 今でも　あの日のことを夢に見るんだよ

English.Text: I'll never forget that day as long as I live.

Text: シロン先生に　薬をもらわないと

English.Text: But some of the doc's stuff oughta help...

Text: どうした　どっかの街から追い出されてきたか？

English.Text:
Don't tell me.
Get-rich-quick scheme blow up in your face again?

Text: また　金に目がくらんだか

English.Text: Tried to sell out another town, huh?

Text: 言わせといていいのかよ～

English.Text: Don't let him talk to you like that!

Text: 気にすんな

English.Text: I can take it.

Text: よく帰ってこれたもんだねえ

English.Text: How dare you show your face here.

Text: さっさと出ていけよ！

English.Text: Get the hell outta here!

Text: バレット　大丈夫？

English.Text: You sure you're okay with this?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah...

Text: 新しい嫁さんかよ　信じられねえ

English.Text: She your new wife? Well, good for you...

Text: 自分だけ　面白おかしく暮らそうってか？

English.Text: Glad someone got their "happy ending"!

Text: ティファ　こらえてくれ

English.Text: Sorry, Tifa. Just ignore 'em.

Text: 誰かさんのおかげで　すっかり無職だよ

English.Text: Been outta work for ages. Wonder why.

Text: 本当なら魔晄炉で働けるはずだったのに

English.Text: So much for that reactor and a "steady paycheck."

Text: はやく村から出てってくれ

English.Text: Do us a favor and scram.

Text: おい　いつまでいるんだよ

English.Text: Hope you're not stickin' around.

Text: なんだよ　文句でもあんのかよ！

English.Text: Uh, what? Was it something I said?

Text: 俺は　みんなの声を代弁しただけだ！

English.Text: Look, I'm just saying what everyone is thinking!

Text: すっかり変わっちまったよ　村も人も

English.Text: This place is nothing like it was─and neither are we.

Text: ここのほかに　居場所なんてないんだよ

English.Text: Can't leave if we've got nowhere else to go.

Text: もうすこしだけ　いい？

English.Text: Should probably stick around for a bit.

Text: 黒マント　探さなくていい？

English.Text: You think the hooded men went this way?

Text: 黒マント　探すんでしょ？

English.Text: What about the dudes in the robes?

Text: どこへ行く

English.Text: Where're you going?

Text:
ねえ　みんな
ちょっと寄っていい？

English.Text: Hey, guys? You mind if I pop in for a minute?

Text: あいさつしたい人がいるの

English.Text: There's someone I wanna see.

Text:
５年前　私はニブルヘイムからここに運ばれて
シロン先生に助けてもらったの

English.Text: When I got hurt back in Nibelheim, they brought me to this clinic. The doctor here─Sheiran...he's the one who saved my life.

Text: ああ

English.Text: Oh...

Text: ティファを治療したのは　シロン先生だったのか

English.Text: You're tellin' me Doc Sheiran's the one who fixed you up?

Text: 来て

English.Text: C'mon.

Text:
惑わされるな
私だけが　おまえの真実だ

English.Text: Do not be deceived. You know the truth. Trust in me.

Text: セフィロス！

English.Text: Sephiroth!

Text: やめて！

English.Text: Stop!

Text: なにやってんだ　おまえ

English.Text: The hell's gotten into you, man?

Text: なにごとだ！

English.Text: What's goin' on!?

Text: バレットじゃないか

English.Text: Barret Wallace!

Text: 先生　久しぶりだな

English.Text: Doctor Sheiran, it's... It's been a while.

Text: 何年ぶりだ？

English.Text: Certainly has.

Text:
ずいぶん　物騒なものを付けたな
まあ　元気そうでなによりだ

English.Text:
That's one frightening-looking appendage
you got there... But hey─least you still seem
to have your health.

Text: 先生もな

English.Text: And you too.

Text:
あちこちガタがきているが
患者を診れば　元気が出るよ

English.Text:
Oh, I'm feelin' the miles,
but the work keeps me truckin'.

Text: それと……

English.Text: I tell ya what, though...

Text: 覚えてますか？

English.Text: Do you remember me?

Text:
もちろんだとも
ティファ　立派になって！

English.Text: Well of course I do, Tifa! It hasn't been that long!

Text: 傷は　もういいのか？

English.Text: You heal up alright?

Text:
おかげさまで
あの時は　本当にありがとうございました

English.Text:
I did, yeah.
I just wanted to drop by and say thank you.

Text: 先生がいてくれなかったら　私は今頃……

English.Text:
If it wasn't for you...
I doubt I'd be standing here today.

Text:
いや　あれは運が良かった
ちょうど　神羅のヘリがいてな

English.Text:
Don't thank me, thank Lady Luck.
And Shinra for that helicopter.

Text: 神羅……ですか？

English.Text: I'm sorry... Shinra?

Text:
覚えていないのも無理はないが
連中も悪いやつらばかりじゃないよ

English.Text: I know you might find it hard to believe, but not all the apples in that bunch're rotten.

Text: ティファ　きみの命は人々の善意で繋がった

English.Text:
But seriously─you're living proof of
the good in people.

Text:
それを忘れちゃいけない
無駄に使うことは　わしが許さんよ

English.Text:
Don't ever forget that.
It'd be a pity to let their kindness go to waste.

Text: はい

English.Text: Yeah.

Text: しかしなんだ　不思議な組み合わせだな

English.Text: Besides, you need to set a good example for your friends here.

Text:
そうだ　ちょうどいいところに来た
手伝ってくれ

English.Text: Right. While I got ya, mind helpin' me out?

Text:
あの患者から血を採りたいんだ
暴れないように押さえてくれんか

English.Text:
Need to draw that gentleman's blood.
Ya think ya could hold him still for me?

Text: この連中の症状は　魔晄中毒のものだ

English.Text: At first, I thought it was just mako poisoning...

Text:
ただ　血液を調べてみたところ
奇妙なことを見つけてね

English.Text:
That is, until I ran some tests.
The results were...strange.

Text: なにか　わかったのか？

English.Text: Strange how?

Text: 血液の中に　わしの知らない成分が入っている

English.Text: A substance turned up─one I've never seen before.

Text:
正体はわからんが
似たような血なら見たことがある

English.Text: Not sure what to make of it yet, but it did remind me of one I have seen.

Text: その目は　ソルジャーなんだろう

English.Text: Your eyes. SOLDIER, right?

Text: 元ソルジャーだ

English.Text: Ex-SOLDIER.

Text:
ソルジャーは職業ではない
いちどなったら　死ぬまでソルジャーだ

English.Text:
It's not a job, son.
Once a SOLDIER, always a SOLDIER.

Text: 血をくれんか？

English.Text: Spare a drop?

Text: 断る

English.Text: No.

Text:
わしはね　彼らは
劣化したソルジャーではないかと考えている

English.Text: I ask 'cause I suspect they're SOLDIERs suffering from cellular degradation.

Text:
あくまでも仮説だがね
実際のところは　もっと調べてみないとわからん

English.Text:
Just a theory for now. And one I can't prove─
not without a lot more testing.

Text: 黒マントは　ほかにも来たんじゃないか？

English.Text: You see many of these guys come through?

Text: ああ　来た来た

English.Text: Yeah, and then some.

Text:
ケガをした連中は保護したが
ほかはゴールドソーサーへ向かったらしい

English.Text: I do what I can for the injured ones, but leave the rest to stumble on to the Saucer.

Text: ゴールドソーサーだ？

English.Text: Why would they go there?

Text:
ああ　理由なんか知らんぞ
わしに聞くな

English.Text: Don't ask me. I think it's odd too.

Text:
あの少女が大人になって
あのバレットといっしょに戻ってくるとは

English.Text: Ain't that somethin'... The girl I saved comin' back here with Barret of all people.

Text:
これは　どんな暗示なのかね
考えてもわからんか

English.Text: Sure there's some kinda cosmic significance to that...but hell if I know what it is!

Text: ティファ　無茶をするんじゃないぞ

English.Text: Promise me you'll take it easy out there, okay, Tifa?

Text: ケガをしたら　いつでも寄りなさい

English.Text: If you get hurt, y'know where to find me.

Text: 診察料は　血を少しばかり分けてくれればいいよ

English.Text:
Won't charge for my services,
but I wouldn't turn down blood neither.

Text: ねえ！

English.Text: So!

Text:
ゴールドソーサーって
あの有名な毎日がお祭りの遊園地でしょ？

English.Text: Doc mentioned the Gold Saucer, right? As in, the amusement park? Where every day is a holiday!?

Text: 行くんでしょ　行くよね？

English.Text: We're going, right? I mean, we have to!

Text: ユフィ　目的は黒マントだ

English.Text: Yuffie. This isn't a vacation.

Text:
イエス　黒マント！
いや～　アタシはじめてだよ～

English.Text:
Yeah, yeah, weird mumblin' guys, got it.
Oh man, this is gonna be so much fun!

Text:
ゴールドソーサーに行くなら
この先にロープウェイがある

English.Text: Town's got a ropeway that'll take us straight there. It's not far.

Text: どうせ行くなら　さっさと行こうぜ

English.Text: If we're doin' this, let's just do it.

Text: 準備はいいな　さっさと行こうぜ

English.Text: Ready? Then let's get a move on.

Text:
ゴールドソーサーへ向かいますか？
（しばらくは北コレルに戻れません）

English.Text:
Head to the Gold Saucer?
You will not be able to return to North Corel for some time.

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: ロープウェイに乗りますか？

English.Text: Ride the ropeway?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

Text: いいえ

English.Text: No

Text: ここが　ロープウェイ乗り場だ

English.Text: This'll take us all the way to the Saucer.

Text:
ねえ　早く行きたいのはやまやまなんだけど
仕返ししなくてもいいわけ？

English.Text: Hey─you can't let those assholes talk to you like that. We should go back and beat 'em up or somethin'!

Text:
バレットが　村のおっさんたちに侮辱されまくって
アタシまでムカついたんだけど

English.Text: Practically the whole damn town came out to crap on him. Someone tell me why I'm the only one who's pissed here!

Text: いいんだ　行こうぜ

English.Text: I told you; I can take it.

Text: 事情も　教えてもらえないのかな

English.Text: Think you could at least tell us what it was all about?

Text:
お金に目がくらんだ　とか言われてたよね
私が知ってるバレットは　そういう人じゃない

English.Text: They were talking like you sold them out for money. But...I know that isn't true. That's not you.

Text: なにか　誤解があるんじゃない？

English.Text: So how'd they get it so wrong?

Text: 来ねえなあ

English.Text: Where the hell is it?

Text: マリンも　コレル生まれだよね

English.Text: This about her? About Marlene?

Text: コレルには良質な石炭が採れる炭坑があってな

English.Text: Corel wasn't much. Decent place with decent coal.

Text:
村の住人は　少々気は荒いが
性根はまっすぐな　そんな連中ばかりだった

English.Text: Decent folks too. Rough around the edges, but...big hearts. Salt of the earth.

Text: それをオレは　メチャクチャにしたんだ

English.Text: And I sold 'em all down the river.

Text: ぜんぶ　オレのせいだ

English.Text: Took away their future...and their hope.

Text: いいところだったぜ

English.Text: We were happy.

Text: ホコリっぽくて貧しかったけどよ のどかで　村のみんな仲が良くてよ

English.Text: Covered in soot and poor as dirt, but none of that mattered. We had friends and family─and that was enough.

Text: それなのに　魔晄という言葉を知ってから すべてが変わっちまった

English.Text: Till we learned about the "miracle of mako" and all we'd been missin' out on. And then we just had to have a taste...

Text: 反対してるのは　ダインだけだが……

English.Text: So, now only Dyne is opposed.

Text: 俺は反対だ　炭坑を捨てるなんてありえない

English.Text: Damn right, I am. We can't just abandon the mines.

Text:
じいさんたち　オヤジたちが
命がけで守ってきた財産だ

English.Text: Not after our fathers and grandfathers risked their lives to maintain 'em.

Text:
でもよ　ダイン
もう石炭なんて誰も使わない

English.Text:
I hear you, Dyne, I do.
But nobody sees any future in coal.

Text:
毎日　体が悲鳴あげるまで働いても
オレたちは　年々貧乏になっていく

English.Text: So I ask you─why break our backs working harder and harder when we're takin' home less year after year?

Text: ダインさん

English.Text: If I may, sir.

Text:
魔晄炉が完成すれば
収益の一部は　村へ還元されます

English.Text: Once the reactor is complete, a portion of the revenue will go to the town.

Text:
みなさんの生活は保障され
いまよりも豊かになるんですよ？

English.Text:
Your community will be preserved─or "enriched,"
I should say.

Text: なあ　ダイン

English.Text: Listen, man.

Text:
オレはミーナに　これ以上
苦しい生活をさせたくねえんだ

English.Text: This is your chance to give the kids here a better life than what we had.

Text: それは　俺だって同じだ！

English.Text: You think I haven't thought about that?

Text:
でも　だからって
石炭が用済みだなんて認めたくない

English.Text: C'mon! Are we gonna let some city slickers tell us our coal is worthless?

Text: 俺たちも　用済みってことなんだぞ

English.Text: We gonna let 'em tell us we're worthless?

Text: これはもう　生き方の違いですね

English.Text: It would seem we've reached an impasse.

Text:
となれば　話し合いで
どうなるものでもないでしょう

English.Text: In which case, any further discussion would be a waste of breath.

Text: 村長　そろそろ票決に移っては？

English.Text: So, Mr. Mayor, shall we put it to a vote?

Text: それでは　決をとる

English.Text: Well then, all in favor?

Text:
それから　２年ほどで魔晄炉が完成して
試験運転も順調だった

English.Text:
Two years later, the reactor was finished...
and the trial run went off without a hitch.

Text:
みんな喜んでたよ
これで　豊かな生活が始まるってな

English.Text:
Everyone was ecstatic─
convinced it was the dawn of a new era.

Text: でも　ある日……

English.Text: Then, one day...

Text: 魔晄炉が　爆発した

English.Text: the reactor exploded.

Text: おまえたちも　山で見たろ？

English.Text: Y'all saw the aftermath.

Text: そしたら　神羅の軍隊がやってきて

English.Text: And then...Shinra came rollin' into town.

Text: 村は焼かれ　大勢が殺された

English.Text: Burned everything. Innocent people in their homes.

Text: スカーレット……スカーレットがやったの？

English.Text: Was it Scarlet? It was, wasn't it?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Yeah...

Text: ひどいなあ

English.Text: That bitch.

Text: でも　どうしてそんなことになるんだ

English.Text: I don't get it. Why burn the whole town?

Text:
爆発は　村の反対派の仕業ってことで
処理しようと考えたらしい

English.Text:
To craft a story─that it was all the work of
a "local insurgent group."

Text:
もちろん　誰も魔晄炉に近寄っちゃいねえ
完全なでっちあげだ

English.Text: But ain't no villager ever gone near the reactor. They lied right through their teeth.

Text: 許せない！

English.Text: Murderers...

Text: ああ　オレも許せねえ　でもよ

English.Text: That they are. Still...

Text: いちばん許せないのは　オレ自身だ

English.Text: There's a whole lotta blood on my hands too.

Text:
魔晄炉に夢を見て
村をその気にさせたのは　オレだからな

English.Text:
I pushed for the reactor.
I put us on the path that brought us here.

Text: バレット……

English.Text: Barret...

Text: さあ　行こうぜ

English.Text: The Saucer's waiting.

Text: あ～　しんきくせえな！

English.Text: Is this really how it's gonna be?

Text: おまえら！

English.Text: Listen.

Text:
慰めとか　てめえのせいじゃないとか
そういうのはいらねえからな

English.Text:
I don't want your sympathy or your pity.
You can keep all of that nonsense.

Text: この後悔は　オレの一部だからよ

English.Text: I did what I did...and I can live with it.

Text: うん　そうだね

English.Text: Right! We gotta shake this off.

Text:
せっかく　ゴールドソーサーに行くんだし
空気を変えなくちゃ！

English.Text: We're about to rock up to the funnest place ever. The Gold Saucer!

Text: 暗い顔してたら　楽しめないもんね

English.Text: So turn those frowns upside down!

Text:
楽しむって　おまえなあ
そんな旅じゃねえだろうが　これは

English.Text: What in the hell─ Ain't no one but you thinkin' about how much "fun" we're gonna have.

Text: ゴールドソーサー　あっちかな

English.Text: Wanna have a look? It's comin' up over there.

Text: ご静聴　ありがとよ

English.Text: Glad to see we're all on the same page.

Text: あれ　忘れものですか？

English.Text: 'Sup, bro! Forget something?

Text:
それとも　さっそく
シーサイド・ジョニーが恋しくなりました？

English.Text: Or did you just miss the unbeatable ambiance of my seaside paradise?

Text:
でも　ちょうどよかった
アニキの腕を見込んでお願いしたいことがあって

English.Text: Either way, I'm glad you're here, 'cause I was actually hoping to ask you for a little favor.

Text:
アニキ　ちょうどいいところに
アニキの腕を見込んで　お願いしたいことがあって

English.Text: Hey, perfect timing, bro! I was actually hoping to ask you for a little favor.

Text: おかげさまで　借金がチャラになったんで

English.Text: As you know, your boy's debt-free.

Text:
ここはババーンと　シーサイド・ジョニーを
リフォームしようと思ったんです……が

English.Text: Figured I'd make the most of my financial solvency and give the inn a total makeover! Thing is...

Text: 人手が足りないのか

English.Text: You short on hands?

Text:
ああ……いや　アニキ
事態はもっとこう　複雑なんです

English.Text:
Ah, if only, my dear bro.
Kinda the opposite problem, actually.

Text:
ああ　ジョニー
君はなんで俺なんだ！

English.Text: O Johnny, a name thou hast claimed as thine!

Text:
おお　ジョニー
俺が君なら　俺はいったい？

English.Text:
But if thou truly Johnny be,
then who, pray tell, am I!?

Text: みたいな　古典的で文学的な問題なんです

English.Text:
So yeah. It's your classic existential crisis.
You get the idea.

Text: はあ？

English.Text: Uh...

Text: ベッドメイキング　終わったぜ～

English.Text: Beds've all been made─what's next?

Text: ええっ？

English.Text: Huh!?

Text: あっ　アニキ！

English.Text: Oh, hey bro!

Text:
だ～っと　おまえは出てくんな
話がややこしくなる！

English.Text:
I told you to stay outta sight!
You're just gonna confuse 'em.

Text:
ほら　買い出しを頼んだろ？
行った行った

English.Text:
Aren't you supposed to be out shopping anyway?
Go on─shoo!

Text: ええ～？

English.Text: Aw...

Text:
ちぇっ　なんだよ
俺だってアニキと話したいのに

English.Text: How come he gets to talk to my bro and I don't? So unfair.

Text: ……というワケなんです

English.Text: ...See what I have to deal with?

Text: ……というワケなんです

English.Text: "...See what I have to deal with?"

Text: そっくりな従業員だな

English.Text: He looks just like you.

Text: 双子だったのか

English.Text: You have a twin?

Text: 忍術の影響か

English.Text: You a ninja?

Text:
あはは……
いくらなんでも　そっくりすぎるでしょう

English.Text: Think you're surprised? Imagine how I felt!

Text: どーも　求人広告を見て来たんですが

English.Text: Good day, sir! I saw your help wanted ad.

Text: うん？　おまえ　どっかで見た顔だな

English.Text: Oh, that's─ Say, you look awfully familiar...

Text:
って　俺？
そんなバカな　どうして

English.Text: Too familiar. You look exactly like me!

Text:
うわわわ　くるな
こないでくれ　あああ～！

English.Text: N-no, please! Stay back! Don't come any closer!

Text: って　そんな怖いヤツ雇いませんよ

English.Text: Okay, that last part was just a joke, but...

Text:
はい　実はそうなんです
いまのは生き別れになった双子の弟　ジャニー

English.Text: It's true. Poor Yanni and I were separated at birth when he was ripped from our mother's arms.

Text:
弟は　モンスターに育てられるという
波乱万丈な人生を……

English.Text: The creatures that stole him brought him up in the wild as one of their own, and─

Text: って　そんなワケないでしょ！

English.Text: No, he's not my twin!

Text:
もしかして　アタシのせい？
アタシが　分身の術をかけたせい？

English.Text: This wouldn't have anything to do with me using my ninja skills to create a bunch of clones...would it?

Text:
何人か　消えずに残っちゃったみたいで
てか　増えてる？

English.Text: Turns out a few of 'em managed to stick around somehow, and I think they might've even multiplied.

Text:
あはは　アタシってば才能ありすぎ～
ありすぎて　術が強すぎたみたい

English.Text: I mean, I never doubted my amazing abilities, but even I didn't realize I was capable of doing that.

Text:
あっ　でもでも
おかげで人手は足りてるんでしょ？

English.Text: But hey, look on the bright side─at least you aren't short-staffed!

Text:
みんな　リフォームの材料を探しに行ったっきり
ぜんっぜん帰ってきません

English.Text: Oh, but I am. I sent a crew to fetch materials and haven't heard a word from 'em since.

Text: 増えたところで　俺は俺ってことです

English.Text: Turns out I can't rely on myself─my other selfs.

Text: アニキ～　手伝ってもらえませんか

English.Text: I'm beggin' ya, bro! You gotta help me out here!

Text:
ほら俺　キケンな野獣の一面もあるじゃないですか
野放しは　危ないと思うんです

English.Text: A Johnny's a wild beast that can't be tamed─you know that! There's no telling what sorta havoc these bad boys might wreak!

Text: ねえ　助けてやんない？

English.Text: Maybe we should lend him a hand?

Text: ……わかった

English.Text: ...Fine.

Text: さすがはアニキ　話がはやい！

English.Text: Yes! I knew I could count on you, bro!

Text:
俺の分身は　材料を探しに
コスタフォールズへ向かったはずです

English.Text: I sent them off to the Costa Falls to look for materials for the renovations.

Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: Might wanna start there!

Text:
俺の分身たちは
コスタフォールズにいると思います

English.Text: You probably wanna start by having a look around the Costa Falls.

Text:
はあ……
みんな　考えナシに動きやがって

English.Text: I suppose I should've known I couldn't be trusted...

Text:
あ～　せっかく集めたのに
モンスターの野郎！

English.Text: Man, if it weren't for those uglies, we woulda been done by now!

Text:
おまえが　しっかり
持ってなかったせいだろ

English.Text: You're the one who dropped all the stuff we collected!

Text:
ちょっと襲われたぐらいで
ビビりやがって

English.Text: Guy like us oughta have more of a backbone.

Text:
おまえこそ悲鳴あげて逃げたじゃねえか
うひゃ～ってよ　情けねえ

English.Text: You're one to talk! Who was it that ran off squealing like a little girl?

Text:
うるせえ　俺もおまえも
ジョニーなんだから仕方ねえだろ

English.Text: Whatever, bro! You probably woulda done the same thing if you were me─which you are!

Text: はあ　どうすりゃいいんだ

English.Text: We're so screwed!

Text: アニキ　どうしてここに？

English.Text: 'Sup, my bro!? What're you doin' here?

Text: ジョニーに　材料を探すよう依頼を受けた

English.Text:
Johnny sent me to check on you guys.
Help you find materials.

Text:
おお　さすがは俺！
最強の助っ人ってワケだ

English.Text:
Whoa, that was pretty smart of me!
No one knows me better than myself.

Text: うへ～　なんか気味ワルいなあ

English.Text:
This whole "synchronized talking"
thing is kinda creepy.

Text:
実は　材料集め終わったんすけど
モンスターに襲われて　落としちまったんです

English.Text: We had actually already gathered everything we needed, but then we ran into some fiends and had to zipline for our lives.

Text:
ジップラインを使って逃げてきたので
たぶん　そのあたりに落ちてると思うんです

English.Text: So unless they took our stuff for some weird reason, everything should still be right where we dropped it. We think.

Text: アニキ　お願いしてもいいですか？

English.Text: You'll help us get it all back, won'tcha, bro?

Text: できるだけ　多く集めてもらえると助かります

English.Text:
The more pieces ya pick up,
the better off me and me'll be!

Text:
けっこー大変そうだね
そうだ　アタシたちも分身しちゃう？

English.Text: This is gonna be tough with just us... Oh! Maybe I could make some clones of me and you to help out!

Text: これ以上　かき乱すな

English.Text: That is a terrible idea.

Text:
ええ～　面白いと思うけどな～
ほら　想像してみてよ

English.Text: Uh, I think you meant to say "terrific" idea? C'mon, Cloud─just imagine how much fun it could be!

Text: うん……？

English.Text: Hmm...

Text: ほい！
ほら

English.Text: Well?

Text: ほらほら～？

English.Text: What'd I tell ya?

Text: ほらほら～

English.Text: What'd I tell ya?

Text: ユフィちゃんがいっぱいだよ

English.Text: More Yuffies, more fun!

Text: ユフィちゃんがいっぱいだよ！

English.Text: More Yuffies, more fun!

Text: ユフィちゃんがいっぱいだよ？

English.Text: More Yuffies, more fun!

Text: ユフィちゃんズに　おまかせあれ！

English.Text: This looks like a job for the Yuffie Squad!

Text: クラウド　あっちに行ってみよ

English.Text: How 'bout we take a look over there?

Text: い～や　あっちのほうが怪しいよ

English.Text: Nah, I think we'd have better luck over there.

Text: マテリアはどこだ～？

English.Text: If it's not materia, I'm not interested!

Text: ウシシシシ！

English.Text: Heh heh!

Text: シュシュシュシュシュ！

English.Text: Sih-sih-sih-sih, hah!

Text: クラウド～？

English.Text: Hey, Cloud!

Text: クラウド？

English.Text: Uh, Cloud?

Text: クラウドってば！

English.Text: Are you even listening to us!?

Text: ねっ　楽しそうでしょ！

English.Text: See? Like I said─fun!

Text: そうは思えない

English.Text: No. Not fun.

Text: ええ～？

English.Text: Boooooo!

Text: アニキがきてくれて　これで百人力だ

English.Text: Havin' our bro help out's like havin' a hundred of us.

Text:
おうおう　実際
俺たち１００人で戦っても負けるよな

English.Text: Even better. Throw a hundred Johnnys in a fight and we'd still get our asses kicked.

Text: そもそも　怖がって誰も戦おうとしねえよ

English.Text: We'd be so scared we'd run before the fight began.

Text: アニキ　見つかりましたか？

English.Text: So, you find anything, bro?

Text: 集めた材料を渡しますか？

English.Text: Give Johnny the materials?

Text: 持っているだけ渡す

English.Text: Yes.

Text: 材料について聞く

English.Text: Need to know where they are first.

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: No.

Text:
あれ？
アニキ　持ってないっすよ

English.Text: Uh, are you pullin' our legs here, bro?

Text: アニキ　ちゃんと集めてくださいよ

English.Text: C'mon, don't leave us hangin'. We need your help!

Text:
ジップラインのそばに落ちてるはずです
できるだけ　多く集めてもらえると嬉しいです

English.Text: They oughta be all around the ziplines─right where we dropped 'em. You'd be doin' us a solid by trackin' 'em down!

Text: アニキ　ちゃんと集めてくださいよ

English.Text: C'mon, don't leave us hangin'. We need your help!

Text: これで　最後だよね

English.Text: That's the last of 'em, right?

Text:
ああ　はい
たしかに受け取りました

English.Text: Yep, this is definitely some of our stuff!

Text:
これなら　ギリッギリですけど
なんとかなりそうです

English.Text: Would've liked all of it, but we're an ingenious guy─we'll make it work.

Text:
おお　これだけあれば
しっかりリフォームできます

English.Text: Nice! With this much, we can renovate the hell outta the hotel.

Text: さすがは　なんでも屋とシノビすっね

English.Text: And it's all thanks to the merc and his ninja pal!

Text:
わお　よくこんだけ見つけてきましたね
これならバッチリです！

English.Text: Whoa! Honestly, we don't even remember collecting this much stuff. You're incredible!

Text: やっぱアニキは　規格外の男だぜ

English.Text: You got that right! Our bro's a cut above.

Text:
じゃあ　俺たちは材料を持って
シーサイド・ジョニーに戻りますね

English.Text: I guess we better get this haul back to our palace kinda sorta by the sea.

Text: これで依頼は完了　いいな

English.Text: Which means our work here is done. Right?

Text:
それが　実はほかのジョニーたちが
ボイラー修理に必要な部品を探しに行ってて

English.Text: Well, since ya asked... A couple of the other Johnnys went lookin' for parts to fix the boiler.

Text: えっ　ほかにもいんの？

English.Text: Wait─there's more of you?

Text: そっちを手伝ってもらえると　嬉しいです

English.Text: Yep─and I bet they could really use your help!

Text:
あいつら　共和国時代に建てられた工場跡地に
向かったっぽいんで　よろしくお願いします

English.Text: Think they were headed toward one of those old republic-era factories. Tell 'em Johnny says hi! It's a thing we do.

Text: どこだ　共和国時代の工場は？

English.Text: We've been looking for hours. We're never gonna find this place!

Text:
やっぱ　俺たちだけで探すのは
無理なんじゃねえか

English.Text: Bet we would've found it already if we had a few more of us to help search!

Text:
いいホテルに　温かいシャワーが
ないなんて　ありえないよな

English.Text: Can't call it a seven-star hotel if we can't even offer a hot shower.

Text: だよな　はやくボイラーを修理しないと

English.Text: Tell me about it. We really gotta fix that boiler!

Text: どこだ　クラフトチップは？

English.Text: Where the hell're we supposed to find a transmuter chip?

Text:
やっぱ　俺たちだけで探すのは
無理なんじゃねえか

English.Text: Bet we would've found it already if we had a few more of us to help search!

Text:
集中して気配を感じるんだ
ピンときたら　すかさず掘る！

English.Text: We just gotta focus all our brainpower on that chip─feel the chip─and start digging!

Text: はあ　おまえがチョコボだったらな

English.Text: Treasure hunting'd be a lot easier if you were a chocobo...

Text: クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: アニキじゃないっすか！

English.Text: Hey there, bro!

Text: ジョニーに頼まれて手伝いにきた

English.Text: Hey, Johnny said that you needed my help.

Text:
ジョニーが？
もしかして　おまえか

English.Text: What? No, I didn't. Wait─was it you?

Text: 俺じゃない

English.Text: Not me!

Text: じゃあ　俺か？

English.Text: So you're saying it was me?

Text: いや　おまえがそんなに気が利くはずない

English.Text: No way. You're too stubborn to ask for help.

Text: ああ？　なんだとコラ

English.Text: Hey! You talkin' shit about me?

Text: あはは　ウケる～！

English.Text: You two are a riot!

Text:
そのまま　ジョニー劇団とかやってみれば？
きっと流行るよ　ねっ！

English.Text:
Have you thought about starting a two-man show?
I bet it'd be a smash hit! Right?

Text: 状況は？

俺たち　ボイラー修理に
必要な部品を探してたんですが

English.Text:
Well, we were lookin' for a part to
help us repair the boiler.

Text: いまは作られてないっぽくて

English.Text: But it turns out nobody makes it anymore.

Text: だったら　いちから作ってやろうと思って

English.Text: Then we thought, "why don't we just make it ourself?"

Text: クラフトチップ探しに切り替えたところです

English.Text: So to do that, we're hunting for a transmuter chip!

Text: 成果は？

English.Text: Any luck?

Text:
このあたりに　共和国時代のバルブ工場が
あったはずなんですけど　見つからなくて

English.Text: None, unfortunately. There's supposed to be a republic-era factory around here somewhere...

Text:
アニキ　俺たちの代わりに
探してもらえませんか？

English.Text: You're way better at findin' stuff than us. Mind bein' our bloodhound, bro?

Text: あとはまかせろ

English.Text: Okay, I'll take it from here...

Text: やった～！

English.Text: Suh-weet!

Text: お話はうかがっていました

English.Text: I heard about your plight.

Text:
共和国時代の情報でしたら
ライフスポットを解析してみてください

English.Text: If you wish to learn more about the Republic of Junon, I recommend visiting lifesprings.

Text:
クラフトチップが眠る場所や
ほかにも　色々とわかるはずです

English.Text: The knowledge they contain will reveal the location of transmuter chips.

Text:
共和国時代のボイラーを使ってるホテルなんて
たぶん　ウチぐらいですよ

English.Text: Some folks might say our hotel's boiler is old, but we prefer to think of it as vintage.

Text: 共和国時代の工場　見つかりましたか？

English.Text: Speaking of which─found that "vintage" factory yet?

Text:
そこに　俺たちが求めるクラフトチップが
眠ってるはずなんです

English.Text: The transmuter chip we're after should be somewhere inside. We're sure of it!

Text: こういう時に　チョコボがいれば

English.Text: Sure wish we had a chocobo right about now...

Text: あとはまかせろ

English.Text: Okay. I'll take it from here...

Text: やった～！

English.Text: Suh-weet!

Text:
俺たちが探してるのは
ボイラーバルブのレシピです

English.Text: We're looking for instructions on how to craft a boiler valve.

Text:
チップを見つけたら
そのまま　クラフトもやっちゃってください

English.Text: And if you find one of those chips, feel free to just transmute a valve yourself!

Text: しれっと仕事を増やしてない？

English.Text: Are you trying to give us even more work?

Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: You two are the best!

Text: アニキ～！

English.Text: Hey, bro!

Text: おお　ここが共和国時代の工場か～

English.Text: So─this is the place, huh? Definitely couldn't have found it without you!

Text:
あとは　チョコボを使って
クラフトチップを掘り出すだけです

English.Text: Now all we need is for you to use a chocobo to sniff out that transmuter chip for us!

Text:
俺たちが探してるのは
ボイラーバルブのレシピです

English.Text: We're looking for instructions on how to craft a boiler valve.

Text:
チップを見つけたら
そのまま　クラフトもやっちゃってください

English.Text: And if you find one of those chips, feel free to just transmute a valve yourself!

Text: しれっと仕事を増やしてない？

English.Text: Are you trying to give us even more work?

Text: よろしくお願いします！

English.Text: You two are the best!

Text:
どうする　アタシたちも分身して
手分けして探す？

English.Text: All I'm saying is we'd find everything much faster if we cloned ourselves too.

Text: やめろ

English.Text: No.

Text:
なんでも屋もチェーン展開できるじゃん
ウータイ支店　作っちゃおうよ

English.Text: Just think: you could start a mercenary franchise! And I could even help you set up a branch in Wutai!

Text:
それに　クラウドがいっぱいれば
神羅との戦争にも勝てるんじゃない？

English.Text: Plus, Shinra wouldn't stand a chance against a Cloud army. You and your buster-sword-wielding buddies'd hack 'em to bits!

Text: どうだろう

English.Text: Yeah, right.

Text: ほら　想像してみようよ

English.Text: Oh, c'mon─just imagine!

Text: ほい！
クラウドがひとり　クラウドがふたり

English.Text: One Cloud...two Clouds...

Text: クラウドが３人　クラウドが４人

English.Text: Three Clouds...four Clouds...

Text:
うう　無言のクラウドがいっぱい
なんか　息が詰まる

English.Text: I know you aren't much of a talker, but I figured at least one of you would say something. Not really diggin' this vibe.

Text: やっぱ　クラウドは増えなくていいかな

English.Text: Yeah... Yeah, I think I'm good with just one Cloud.

Text: 俺もそう思う

English.Text: The one and only.

Text:
チョコボがいないなら　俺たちが
チョコボになっちまえばいいんだ

English.Text: We don't need a chocobo─'cause we can be our own chocobo!

Text: そのとおりだクエ！

English.Text: Hey, that's kweh-ver!

Text: さあ行け　ジョニーチョコボ！

English.Text: Right? Now giddyup, Johnny!

Text: クエッ　ここ掘れクエ！

English.Text: Here! X warks the spot!

Text: そこ　さっきも掘ってなかったか？

English.Text: Wait, didn't we try digging there before?

Text: 俺を信じろクエ

English.Text: Kweh'mon─trust me!

Text: チップはどこだクエ！

English.Text: Kweh-re's that chip!?

Text: おっ　いまなにか光らなかったか？

English.Text: Hey─see that? A glint of light─maybe metal!?

Text: 俺の嗅覚を信じろクエ

English.Text: Time to put my sniffer to wark!

Text: チップって　どんなニオイがすんだ？

English.Text: Wait. What does a chip smell like?

Text: チョコボの嗅覚さえあれば　いっぱつなんですけど

English.Text: Sure wish I had a chocobo's sense of smell right about now...

Text: はあ　本物のチョコボさえいればな～

English.Text: I just wish we had a chocobo...

Text:
チョコボなら　コスタのレンタルショップで
会員になれば手に入りますよ

English.Text: You can rent a chocobo from that shop in Costa del Sol. Members only, but still.

Text:
このあたりに
クラフトチップが埋まってるはずです

English.Text: That transmuter chip's here─I can feel it!

Text:
アニキとチョコボの力で
バシッと見つけちゃってください

English.Text: All you and your bird gotta do is start sniffin' and dig that sucker up!

Text:
チップを見つけてくれたんですね
ありがとうございます！

English.Text: Whoa, you actually found the chip? Way to go, bro!

Text:
あとは　レシピどおりに素材を集めて
クラフトするだけです　がんばってください

English.Text: Once you've got all the necessary materials, you can transmute us a brand-new boiler valve!

Text: アニキ　もしかして手間取ってます？

English.Text: Hey bro. You're not...slackin' off, are you?

Text:
あとは　レシピどおりに
ボイラーバルブをクラフトするだけですよ

English.Text: That valve isn't gonna transmute itself, y'know─though that'd be sweet.

Text: ボイラーバルブを渡しますか？

English.Text: Hand over the boiler valve?

Text: 渡す

English.Text: Yes

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: No

Text:
おお　これです！
これでボイラーを修理できます

English.Text: Oh, baby, this is it! That boiler is as good as fixed.

Text: 熱々のシャワーを提供できます

English.Text: Hot, steamy showers in every room!

Text:
んじゃ　ジョニーもぜんぶ見つけたし
報告に戻る？

English.Text: Well, we should probably report back to Johnny now that we've bailed out all the others.

Text: ああ　いや……それが

English.Text: Uh, actually...

Text: あと　ひとり

English.Text: There's one more.

Text: えっ　まだいんの？

English.Text: Where is he!?

Text:
シーサイド・ジョニーに　伝説のモンスター
トンベリキングの王冠を飾るんだって

English.Text: Said he wanted to give the hotel royal flair by putting the Tonberry King's crown on display.

Text: 砂漠のほうへ　狩りに行ったヤツが

English.Text: Last we heard, he was desert-bound.

Text: あいつ　干からびてないといいけど

English.Text: Hope he's not dying of thirst or knife wounds.

Text: アニキ　様子を見てきてもらっていいですか

English.Text: You wouldn't mind going to check on him for us, would ya, bro?

Text: わかった

English.Text: Not at all.

Text: 恩に着ます！

English.Text: You're the best!

Text:
それじゃあ　俺たちは
ボイラーを修理しに戻ります

English.Text: Welp, we got a boiler to fix, so we're gonna head back.

Text: ジョニーのこと　よろしく頼んます

English.Text: Our other life is in your hands, bro!

Text:
わっ　アニキ
なにしてるんですか！

English.Text: Is that a mirage? I can't believe you're here, bro!

Text: おまえこそ

English.Text: Me neither.

Text:
実は　リフォームの目玉として
伝説のモンスター

English.Text:
Well, I'm glad you are.
Y'see, we're renovating the hotel.

Text:
トンベリキングの王冠を
バシッと飾ろうと思ったんですけど

English.Text: And I thought a Tonberry King's crown would give the place that palatial feel.

Text: ここから先　進めなくて

English.Text: But it's, uh, somewhere over there.

Text:
この先で　トンベリキングを見たって
情報があるんです

English.Text:
Rumor has it the Tonberry King
lives somewhere nearby.

Text: でも　ここから歩きじゃ無理なんすよ

English.Text: But there's no way your boy Johnny can get through the desert on foot.

Text:
アニキ　もし砂漠へ行くことがあったら
俺の代わりに

English.Text: Listen, bro: I dunno if you were planning to check out the dunes, but if you are...

Text:
トンベリキングの王冠を　なるべく傷つけないように
盗んできてもらってもいいですか

English.Text: you'd really be doing me a solid if you brought me back that crown─preferably in the most pristine condition possible.

Text: あとは　俺たちにまかせろ

English.Text: Fine. Just sit tight.

Text:
まずは　砂漠に入る方法を探さなきゃ
でも　すぐには無理っぽいね

English.Text: I hope you know a way into the desert, Cloud, 'cause I sure don't. Over the mountains? Or something?

Text: 珍しいモンスターなら　通信塔で探し出せるよね

English.Text:
Say, I bet one of those towers
could point us in the king's direction.

Text: あとは　俺たちにまかせろ

English.Text: Fine. Just sit tight.

Text: トンベリキングの居場所なら　もうわかってるよね

English.Text:
We already know where to find the king.
Just gotta pay him a visit.

Text: トンベリキングならもう倒しちゃったよ……ね？

English.Text:
Actually, we already dethroned that royal reject.
Didn't we?

Text:
くう～　男前がすぎるよアニキ！
ちゃちゃっと王冠　盗んできちゃってください

English.Text:
Your kindness is bringing me to tears, bro!
I eagerly await your safe and fruitful return.

Text:
俺　いつまでも待ってますから
忘れちゃうと　干からびちゃいますから

English.Text: Just don't keep me waiting too long. We Johnnys are delicate flowers that wilt in the desert heat.

Text: クラウドさん

English.Text: Cloud!

Text:
トンベリの頂点に君臨する王様　トンベリキングの
居場所らしき情報が見つかりました

English.Text: Good news. I believe I've ascertained the whereabouts of your royal quarry: the Tonberry King.

Text: ジョニーさんが　お待ちかねです

English.Text: Johnny wasn't that far off.

Text:
彼が干からびてしまう前に
王冠を盗んで　届けてあげましょう

English.Text: Let's not keep your entrepreneurial friend waiting, lest he wither in the heat.

Text: トンベリを束ねる　伝説の王様が相手か～

English.Text: This king guy's probably got a horde of tonberries at his command...

Text:
ねえ　アタシらも
分身して対抗したほうがよくない？

English.Text: Which means we'll be outnumbered. Unless...

Text:
ほら　バレットを増やして
銃弾の雨あられ作戦とか

English.Text: What if we cloned a bunch of Barrets? They'd blast those baddies into oblivion!

Text: 相撃ちになるのがオチだ

English.Text: And catch us in the cross fire.

Text: え～　じゃあ　ティファは？

English.Text: Okay, what about...Tifa?

Text: どんな想像した？

English.Text: Thinking naughty thoughts?

Text: 想像しなかった

English.Text: Shut up.
Busted!

Text: ユフィ　黙ってくれ

English.Text: I thought ninjas were supposed to be silent.

Text:
あっ　ごめんごめん
黙るから　好きなだけ想像して

English.Text: Oh, forgive me for interrupting your fantasies. I'll let you get back to being a perv.

Text:
トンベリキングの王冠は盗めるらしいんすよ
上物　期待してます

English.Text: I bet you'll just yoink the crown right off the king's head. Can't wait to see it in person!

Text:
俺　いつまでも待ってますから
忘れちゃうと　干からびちゃいますから

English.Text: Just don't keep me waiting too long. We Johnnys are delicate flowers that wilt in the desert heat.

Text: アニキ～　砂漠へ行けましたか？

English.Text: Hey, bro! You take a look around the desert yet?

Text:
大変お忙しいかと思いますが
トンベリキング探しのほうも頼んます

English.Text: I'm sure you've got a lot of things on your to-do list, but I hope snagging that crown is still one of 'em!

Text: ああ～　王冠傷つけちゃったね

English.Text: Ouch... Looks like the crown got a little scuffed in the scuffle.

Text:
どうする　これ　ジョニーに届ける？
もう１回戦って盗んでみる？

English.Text: Whaddya think? Should we give it to Johnny anyway─see if he even notices? Or should we try for a nicer one instead?

Text:
トンベリキングの王冠　ゲ～ット！
さっそくジョニーに届けてあげよ

English.Text: Another crown snatched by the incomparable Yuffie! Let's hurry up and get this to Johnny!

Text:
おお　トンベリキングを倒してくれたんですか？
さっすが俺たちのアニキだ

English.Text:
You took down the Tonberry King─for us!?
Thanks, bro! On behalf of all Johnnys!

Text: それで　王冠は？

English.Text: So where's the crown?

Text: トンベリキングの王冠　手に入りました？

English.Text: So where's the king's crown? You got it, right?

Text: トンベリキングの王冠を渡しますか？

English.Text: Give the Tonberry King's crown to Johnny?

Text: キズだらけの王冠を渡す

English.Text: Hand over the marred one.

Text: キレイな王冠を渡す

English.Text: Hand over the pristine one.

Text: 王冠の入手方法は？

English.Text: Ask how he thinks you'll get the crown.

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: Hold on to it for now.

Text:
トンベリキングの王冠は盗めるらしいんすよ
上物　期待してます

English.Text: I bet you'll just yoink the crown right off the king's head. Can't wait to see it in person!

Text:
くう～！
アニキ　じらしますねえ

English.Text: Ohoho! Looks like someone's playing hard to get.

Text:
なるほど　おあずけっすね
了解です！

English.Text: But hey, if you wanna hang on to it a little longer, that's cool.

Text:
うん？　えっと～これは……
もうアニキったら　またまたご冗談を

English.Text: Huh? This is...not exactly what I was... Oh, good one, bro! You almost had me thinking you were serious.

Text:
伝説の王冠は
もっとキレイでゴージャスなはずです

English.Text: I mean, the Tonberry King's crown is supposed to be regal and resplendent!

Text:
アニキ　本当に
このキズだらけの王冠であってます？

English.Text: There's no way this hunk a' junk is the crown I was lookin' for...right?

Text:
アニキ　本当に
このキズだらけの王冠であってます？

English.Text: There's no way this hunk a' junk is the crown I was lookin' for...right?

Text: 本当にキズだらけの王冠であってます？

English.Text: Hand over the marred crown?

Text: 絶対あってる

English.Text: Yes

Text: やっぱり違う

English.Text: No

Text:
そうですか　アニキがそこまで言うなら
これが伝説の王冠なんですね

English.Text: Huh... Well, uh, if you say so, bro. Guess some legends just don't live up to the hype.

Text:
まあよく見たら　このオンボロ感が逆に文学的で
インテリアにはちょうどいい気がしてきました

English.Text: But y'know, the worse-for-wear look does imbue it with a certain old-school charm─perfect for a rustic centerpiece!

Text: アニキ　ありがとうございます

English.Text: Thanks again, bro. I owe you one!

Text: それじゃあ　俺は先に戻りますね

English.Text: I'm gonna take this baby back to the hotel.

Text:
時間がある時に　ウチに寄ってください
俺が報酬を用意してると思うんで

English.Text: Be sure to swing by when you have the chance! I'm sure one of me'll have somethin' real nice waiting for ya.

Text:
ですよね　その王冠はなにかの間違いですよね
もう　びっくりさせないでくださいよ

English.Text: Whew! For real, I was this close to having a heart attack. The whole deadpan delivery really had me goin'!

Text:
伝説の名にふさわしい　キレイな王冠を
トンベリキングから盗んできてください

English.Text: Now I'm super pumped to see the real crown, in all its shiny and unscuffed glory!

Text:
うおお　これが伝説の王冠！
なんて神々しいんだ

English.Text:
Whoa! Get a load of the shine on that baby!
It is positively legendary!

Text: そこそこ大変だったんだから　感謝してよね

English.Text: And we went through "positively legendary" trouble to get it for you.

Text:
そりゃもう！
シーサイド・ジョニーのシンボルにします

English.Text:
Don't worry!
The fruits of your labor are gonna be on full display.

Text:
こうしちゃいられない
はやく帰って　俺に知らせないと

English.Text:
Man, I can't wait to see the look on my face
when I see this!

Text: それじゃあ　俺は先に戻りますね

English.Text: I'm gonna take this baby back to the hotel.

Text:
時間がある時に　ウチに寄ってください
俺が報酬を用意してると思うんで

English.Text: Be sure to swing by when you have the chance! I'm sure one of me'll have somethin' real nice waitin' for ya.

Text: リフォーム　リフォーム！

English.Text: Hotel renovation!♪

Text: 丁寧に　丁寧に

English.Text: Careful, Johnny, careful...

Text:
走れ～
走れ～スタンプ～っと

English.Text: Go all out, go all out, go all out li'l Stamp♪

Text: 気をつけろよ

English.Text: Careful up there.

Text: そこ　ムラになってんぞ

English.Text: You gotta spread it evenly.

Text: そろそろ代われよ

English.Text: Why don't you just let me do it?

Text: おい　ペンキが飛んでんぞ！

English.Text: Try painting the walls, not me!

Text: コツをつかんできたぞ

English.Text: Think I'm gettin' the hang of it!

Text: もう　指を叩くのはゴメンだ

English.Text: Haven't whacked my finger in a minute now!

Text: コツコツとやっていきますよ～

English.Text: These nails won't know what hit 'em!

Text: ここが終わったら　次は屋根だな

English.Text: After this, it's time for some roof repairs.

Text: お湯よ　出ろ！

English.Text: Show me the hot water!

Text: 勢いはよし

English.Text: Got a good stream.

Text: すこしずつ熱くなってる気が　する？

English.Text: I think it's getting hotter...kinda...sorta.

Text:
くそ～　もう１回
ボイラーのほうを点検するか

English.Text: Better take another look at that stupid boiler...

Text: ギコギコと

English.Text: Chop, chop!

Text: いい感じ　いい感じ

English.Text: Not bad if I do saw so!

Text: これは床のぶん　次は屋根のぶん

English.Text: Floorboards are set; now for some rafters.

Text: 熱～いシャワーが浴びてえな

English.Text: Man, I could go for a hot shower...

Text: 腹が減っては　リフォームできぬ

English.Text: Can't renovate on an empty stomach!

Text: ジョニー特製　スタミナスープですよ～

English.Text: Whipped up a nice pot of Johnny's special soup!

Text:
う～ん　このかおり
たまらん！

English.Text: Mmm, the smell alone's got my mouth watering!

Text: おっと　ヨダレが落ちるところだった

English.Text: Whoops! Almost drooled in the soup.

Text: 俺たちが戻ってきました　ありがとうございます

English.Text: A couple of me made it back to the hotel, safe and sound.

Text:
リフォームは順調ですよ
楽しみにしていてください！

English.Text: They're already hard at work on the renovations. It's gonna look awesome!

Text: 残りのジョニーのことも　どうかお願いします

English.Text: Take care of the rest of me in the meantime, okay bro?

Text: アニキ　俺たちが全員帰ってきました！

English.Text: Good news, bro! All of me made it back in one piece!

Text:
いろいろと助けてもらったみたいで
ありがとうございます

English.Text: And it sounds like I really put you through the wringer. Sorry 'bout that.

Text:
で　どうする
忍術といちゃう？

English.Text: No biggie. So...what now? Want me to poof 'em?

Text: いや　ちょっとタンマ！

English.Text: What? No, not yet!

Text:
リフォームはこれからが本番なんで
もうちょっと　働いてもらいます

English.Text: We're in the middle of renovating, and I'm gonna need all my hands on deck to finish.

Text:
シーサイド・ジョニーは
自分の手だけで　生まれ変わらせたいんで

English.Text: At the end of the day, I wanna be able to say I remodeled this place all by myselves.

Text: なあ　おまえら！

English.Text: Right, Johnnys?

Text: おう！

English.Text: Yeah, bro!

Text:
というワケで　ババーンと
コスタでいちばんの

English.Text: So yeah, me and mes are set on seein' this through to the end.

Text:
いや　世界一のホテルに
リフォームしちゃいますんで　しばしお待ちを！

English.Text: But once we're finished, it's gonna be the finest hotel in the whole world─just you wait!

English.Text: Wow!

Text:
そうそう　アタシの忍術のおかげなんだから
感謝してよね

English.Text: Couldn't've done it without the J-Squad either.

English.Text: Oh, don't go gettin' all sentimental. We were just doin' what you woulda done!

おまえこそ
こんな俺たちをまとめてくれて　ありがとな

Text: 俺たちは　おまえが誇らしいよ

English.Text: Truly, you are the realest bro, bro.

Text:
へへ　これからもジョニー軍団
力を合わせて　がんばっていこうな

English.Text: Uh, yeah, about that...

English.Text: What?

Text: ジョニー　あとはまかせた

English.Text: Johnny...

English.Text: Johnnys!

Text: ジョニー……

English.Text: Johnnys...

最初は口々にわめいて
うるさいだけだったのに

English.Text: Y'know...I couldn't stand listening to them bicker...

いつしか　あいつらの声に
勇気づけられている俺がいて

English.Text: I lost a part of myself today...

English.Text: You gonna let that stop you?

English.Text: Hmm?

Text: 勝負は　これからだ

English.Text: You've got a hotel to run.

English.Text: That's true...

Text:
みんなで作った　このニュー・シーサイドジョニー
あいつらのぶんまで　俺が盛りあげていかないと

English.Text: I remodeled this place with my own fourteen hands. I owe it to me and my selfs to see that our hard work doesn't go to waste!

English.Text: Oh, yeah! I'm gonna be seven Johnnys in one!

English.Text: Think one of you's more than enough.

あっ　そうだ

Text:
もし　世界の珍品名品が手に入ったら
声かけてください

English.Text: I'd love to showcase any rare or interesting artifacts you happen to come across.

Text:
シーサイド・ジョニーは　これから
ホテル界のテッペン目指して　がんばります

English.Text: I've got my heart set on becoming the best in the business, so look out, hotel industry!

Text:
いついかなる時でも　極上のおもてなしで
お客様のお帰りをお待ちしています

English.Text: We'll attract guests from far and wide with luxurious lodgings and unbeatable hospitality!

Text:
コスタにお越しの際は
ぜひ　シーサイド・ジョニーをご利用ください！

English.Text: But you'll always have a room with your name on it, my bro, 'cause when you're here, you're Johnny!

English.Text: Oh! Already got somethin' you wanna show off?

English.Text: Got anything rare and exotic for me?

English.Text: How's the collect-a-thon coming, bro?

English.Text: If you come across any cool curios, you know where to bring 'em.

Text:
預かったコレクションは
大切に保管させていただきます

English.Text: We'll display your donations with pride in our exclusive collection.

English.Text: Our guests can't stop raving about all the artifacts you've donated!

Text: さんはい！

English.Text: Three, four!

Text:
ちゃちゃちゃちゃ～ちゃ～
ちゃ～ちゃっちゃちゃ～！

English.Text: Duh-duh-duh duuun duuun duuun dun duh-duuun!♪

Text:
アニキ　すべてのコレクション
たしかに預からせていただきました

English.Text: Thanks to all your hard work, bro, I'm proud to announce our collection is finally complete.

Text:
これで　シーサイド・ジョニーは
７つ星のホテルになれたのかもしれません

English.Text: It's only a matter of time till we're certified as a seven-star hotel.

Text:
いや　俺の胸の中では
７つ星がキラキラと輝いてます

English.Text: And I'll always remember that you're the guy who helped me turn that dream into a reality.

Text: ありがとう～　アッニキ～！

English.Text: Thank you so much, bro, for everything!

Text: ありがとう～　アッニキ～！

English.Text: Thank you so much, bro, for everything!

Text: ありがとう～　アッニキ～……

English.Text: Thank you so much, bro, for everything!

Text:
アニキ　遊びにきてくれたんですね
ゆっくりしていってください

English.Text: Hey, bro! Here to admire the collection? It's become a real tourist attraction.

Text:
アニキのコレクションのおかげで
お客さんの予約が　ひっきりなしですよ

English.Text: I've got guests coming from all over to see the stuff you've donated. We're all booked up!

Text:
預かったコレクションは
大切に保管させていただきます

English.Text: We'll display your donations with pride in our exclusive collection.

Text:
あっ　アニキ！
シーサイド・ジョニーで街のガイドを始めたんすよ

English.Text: Hey, bro! Guess what? We just started offering guided tours at the hotel.

Text:
ジョニーがすばやく　楽しくご案内！
さあ　どちらへ向かわれますか

English.Text: Get around town in a flash with Johnny's fast travel service! So─where to?

Text: ジョニーが　コスタをご案内しますよ～！

English.Text: Your boy Johnny'll get you wherever you wanna go!

Text: どちらにご案内しましょう

English.Text: Where ya headed, bro?

Text: いつでも　声をかけてくださいね

English.Text: Feel free to hit me up whenever, bro.

Text: コスタのガイドは　ジョニーにおまかせください

English.Text: Johnny's here to serve all your fast travel needs.

Text:
とうちゃ～く！
それでは　コスタを存分に楽しんでくださいね

English.Text: Well, here we are! Now go on and enjoy some good old-fashioned fun in the sun!

Text:
着きました～！
またのご利用をお待ちしておりま～す

English.Text: And we made it! Thank you for using Johnny's fast travel service!

Text: シーサイド・ジョニーが　コスタをご案内します

English.Text: Welcome to Johnny's Seaside Travel Service!

Text: どちらへご案内いたしましょう

English.Text: Hi! Where are you heading today?

Text: また　いつでもどうぞ～！

English.Text: Come back anytime.

Text: ご利用の際は　お声がけください

English.Text: I'll be right here if you change your mind!

Text:
到着で～す！
では　バケーションをお楽しみください

English.Text: Here we are. I hope you have an awesome time in Costa del Sol!

Text:
到着しました～！
またのご利用　お待ちしてま～す

English.Text: And with that, my work is done. Enjoy your stay, and don't be a stranger!

Text: あなた　神羅の博士と戦ってた人でしょ

English.Text: You're the one who got into it with that Shinra scientist.

Text: わわ　ホントだ！

English.Text: Oh, wow─it is you!

Text: 私は　フレン

English.Text: I'm Fran.

Text: あたし　ノエミ

English.Text: And I'm Naomi.

Text: ボクは　ヨルダ

English.Text: Name's Yorda.

Text:
さっそくなんだけど
あなた　仕事をしてみない？

English.Text: And we would like to hire you for a job. Interested?

Text: 内容による

English.Text: That depends.

Text:
えっとね　彼女さんとふたりで
デートしてほしいの！

English.Text:
It's simple. Girl and boy go on a date.
Easy-peasy, right?

Text: わたし？

English.Text: A date?

Text:
私たち　コスタで水着を中心とした
アパレルショップを経営しているの

English.Text: The three of us are designers for Costa del Sol's premier fashion boutique.

Text: それで　来シーズンは

English.Text: For our next line...

デートで着ていきたくなる水着をコンセプトに
勝負をかけようと思ってるんだけど

English.Text: we're thinking something sexy─perfect for the beach, the bar, or in the boudoir.

Text:
肝心の新作水着のデザインが
ぜ～んぜん　思い浮かばないの！

English.Text:
But creatively speaking, it's been a struggle.
We've been racking our brains forever!

Text: もうすぐ　発表会なのに！

English.Text: And the showcase is basically now.

Text:
危機的状況ってわけ
そこで　ここはひとつ

English.Text: It's do or die, and we don't wanna kill our careers. So!

Text:
実際にデートをしているカップルを観察して
参考にしようと思ったんだ

English.Text: That's where you come in. We wanna see a real couple on a date─for inspiration.

Text: どう　引き受けてくれない？

English.Text: Well? Sound like a good gig?

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: どうして俺たちが？

English.Text: Ask why they picked you two.

Text: 宝条博士について

English.Text: Ask about Hojo.

Text: 引き受けよう

English.Text: Take the job.

Text: あなた　ズバリ押しに弱いでしょ

English.Text: 'Cause we can tell you like your women assertive.

Text:
女の子が　デートをぐいぐいと引っ張る
っていうのがコンセプトなんだ

English.Text: And since we're all about strong, confident ladies, we thought "ka-ching!"

Text:
そんでもって　あなたは
ぐいぐいと引っ張っていくタイプでしょ？

English.Text: One look at you, and we knew "That woman's not afraid to take what she wants."

Text: それは……う～ん　どうかな

English.Text: Maybe? I mean, uh...I'd like to think so.

Text: 宝条って　あの神羅の博士さん？

English.Text: "Hojo" as in...that Shinra guy?

Text: 私たちは　市長に頼まれて接待しただけ

English.Text: We were just doing the mayor a favor. That's all.

Text:
神羅にコネができれば
ミッドガルに出店できるかと思ったけど

English.Text: And if we're being honest, we figured it couldn't hurt to butter up a company bigwig.

Text: 見込み違いだったな

English.Text: We got a business to run.

Text: ありがとう　それじゃあ

English.Text: We knew you would! And so...

Text: デートコースは　あたしたちにまっかせなさい！

English.Text:
We've already planned the perfect date
for lovebirds like you.

Text: あたしは　ラン・ワイルド！

English.Text: Get rowdy at Run Wild!

English.Text: Be ready to swashbuckle at Pirate's Rampage!

Text:
ふたりは　コスタの景色を楽しみながら
ゆっくり来てね

English.Text:
This is going to be your best date yet!
We'll make sure of it!

Text:
ボクも　とっておきのデートプランを
用意しておくよ

English.Text: You're going to absolutely love what we've cooked up for you.

Text:
まずは　ノエミとフレンが用意した
デートを楽しんで

English.Text:
First, find Naomi and Fran.
They'll kick-start your date.

Text:
フレンはパイレーツ・ランページ
ノエミはラン・ワイルドで待ってるよ

English.Text: They'll be waiting for you at Run Wild and Pirate's Rampage. Have fun!

English.Text: This is one of the stranger jobs you've accepted.

English.Text: Still a job. I'll take the lead.

English.Text: Hey, I can help. I'll make this date our best yet!

English.Text: We could just keep it simple.

English.Text: And what's a "simple date" in your world?

English.Text: Like a walk...?

English.Text: Across...rooftops, perhaps?

Text: ああ

English.Text: Sure...

English.Text: Ah, memories.

ふふ　来たわね
それじゃあ　恋のハンティングといきましょうか

English.Text: Look who it is. So, are you ready to aim and fire?

マトといっしょに
彼女のハートも撃ち抜いちゃいなさい

English.Text: Do well and you might just land a bull's-eye on her heart.

English.Text: Locked and loaded?

English.Text: Yes

English.Text: No

English.Text: Just let me know when you wanna give it a shot.

English.Text: Try again?

Text: はい

English.Text: Yes

English.Text: No

English.Text: Knock 'em dead, handsome!

English.Text: Have fun!

English.Text: You got this!

Text: ゴーゴー！

English.Text: Go, go!

Text: その調子！

English.Text: Yeah, keep it up!

Text: バッチリ！

English.Text: Perfect!

Text: すごい！

English.Text: Wow!

Text: さっすが～！

English.Text: Nice one!

Text: やった！

English.Text: Sweet!

Text: やったね！

English.Text: You did it!

Text: よ～し　バッチリ！

English.Text: Awesome!

Text: クラウド　じょうず！

English.Text: Oho! Someone's confident.

Text: いいねいいね～！

English.Text: Great job!

English.Text: What were you aiming at?

English.Text: Not a good look.

English.Text: So close!

English.Text: Oh, so close...

English.Text: Wowza...

English.Text: Aw, man...

English.Text: Uh...

English.Text: Hmm...

へえ　あなた　ただモノじゃないわね
彼女さんはどうだった？

English.Text: Wow, look at that score! Those are some pro numbers. But...what'd the lady think?

English.Text: Oh! Got me right through the heart...the cad!

Text: 胸ではなく　頭を狙ったほうが確実だ

English.Text:
You know...
the secret is to aim for the head, not the heart.

Text:
まあまあかな～？
わたしのほうが　うまいかも

English.Text: Alright, not bad. Though I'm pretty sure I've got better aim.

Text:
彼女さんが　彼氏さんを撃ち抜いちゃう？
それもアリね

English.Text: Now here's a woman who knows how to hunt for a man! I like.

Text: 剣なら　もっとやれた

English.Text: I'm better with a sword.

Text:
なんだろ　ちょっとキュンとしちゃった
ダメなクラウドも　それはそれでアリかも

English.Text: You know...in a weird way, that was actually kinda cute─seeing a guy like you fail that hard.

Text:
なるほど　ダメな男も需要はあるってわけね
勉強になるわ

English.Text: Interesting... So there is a market for total losers. The more you know.

Text: 銃は　久しぶりだったからな

English.Text: It's been a while since I used a gun, okay?

男の子ががんばる姿
それを眺める　彼女の眼差し

English.Text:

And the way she stared at him...

English.Text: The score didn't matter.

ありがとう　いいものを見せてもらったわ
私は水着を仕立てに　店へ戻るわね

English.Text: Thanks, cuties. That was just what I needed. I'll head back, now that the creative juices are flowing again.

ふたりはデートを続けてね
ノエミが　ラン・ワイルドで待ってると思うから

English.Text:
You two, however, still have a date to finish.
Go find Naomi at Run Wild.

ヨルダが　最後のデートを用意してるみたい
チョコボのレンタルショップまで行ってみて

English.Text: You two find Yorda. She should be over by the chocobo stables, just outside of town.

English.Text: I wonder what the girls have next on the agenda for us.

English.Text: More cheap date ideas?

クラウド　考えすぎ
楽しもう！

English.Text: Oh, lighten up. We're trying to enjoy ourselves!

English.Text: 'Cause I'm no romantic.

English.Text: Believe me, I know.

早くしないとレースが始まっちゃうよ

Better hurry or the game'll start without you!

コスタ名物　ラン・ワイルドだよ
ボールを転がして競争するの

動物に癒やされつつ　白熱するレース！
ねっ　デートにはぴったりでしょ？

English.Text: Are you ready to go?

English.Text: No

English.Text: Yes

English.Text: No

English.Text: Alright...wish me luck, okay?

聞いていなかったのか
これは　動物のレースだ

人間だって動物
ねっ　問題ないよね

English.Text: Wrong. Not cool.

Text: ええ～　そんなあ

English.Text: What? I really can't compete?
