English.Text: No, but your pet can.

Text:
断じて　ペットではないが……
私の出番のようだな

English.Text:
Though I take umbrage with that nomenclature...
I'm happy to offer my assistance.

Text: オイラ　駆けっこしたい！

English.Text: My time to shine!

Text: レッドにまかせよう

English.Text: Red's got this.

Text: ナナキにまかせよう

English.Text: Nanaki's got this.

Text: じゃあ　わたしたち　応援団だね

English.Text: Well...I guess we'll just have to be the cheer squad!

Text: チーム・レッド　レディ・ゴー！

English.Text: Gimme an R, gimme an E, gimme a D!

Text: すごいじゃん　まるで赤いイナズマ！

English.Text: You were like a red bolt shooting across that field!

Text: 強い者が勝つ

English.Text: I am quick on my feet.

Text: へへ　まあね～

English.Text: Haha! That's me.

Text: 今度は　わたしたち３人で競争する？

English.Text: The three of us should go a round sometime! Wouldn't that be fun?

Text: 受けて立とう

English.Text: If you enjoy losing.

Text: いいね　やろやろ！

English.Text: Yeah, that does sound fun!

Text: おしい～！

English.Text: You did real good.

Text: スパートをかけるのが　すこし遅かったか

English.Text: Not good enough. I was sloppy.

Text: 最後　ちょっとバテちゃった

English.Text: Could've finished stronger...

Text: あはは　ドンマイ

English.Text: Next time.

Text: こんなはずでは……

English.Text: What a disaster.

Text: オイラ　のろまのナナキだ

English.Text: Ugh... I totally screwed that up.

Text: ちょっと　調子悪かったのかな

English.Text: Don't beat yourself up. You had an off day, that's all.

Text: そういう日もある

English.Text: Yeah, it happens.

Text: 気休めは不要　いまから走りこんでくる

English.Text: I don't need your pity. What I need is to train.

Text: こんな日はいらない　オイラ練習する！

English.Text: Not anymore it won't─not if I train harder!

Text: ふんふん　ペットが繋いだふたりの絆

English.Text: Hm... Their dog is the glue that binds their relationship...

Text:
それは　ワンちゃんが動きまわることによって
より強く　かたくなっていく

English.Text: And watching their little guy give it his all out there only served to strengthen their bond...

Text:
ピコーン　あたし閃いちゃった
あふれだすイマジネーション！

English.Text: That's it─I'm such a genius! I've got to get this idea down on paper!

Text:
こうしちゃいらんない
あたし　お店に戻るね！

English.Text: I need to get back to the shop, like, yesterday!

Text:
パイレーツ・ランページでフレンが待ってるから
おふたりさんは引き続き　デートを楽しんでね～！

English.Text: Fran's over at Pirate's Rampage, by the way. She'll make sure the next part of your date is a blast!

Text: ヨルダが　最後のデートを用意して待ってるから

English.Text: Yorda's at the stables for the final part of your date.

Text:
おふたりさんは
チョコボのレンタルショップへ　ゴー！

English.Text:
So what're you waiting for?
Get those tushies on a chocobo!

Text: 新作水着　楽しみだね

English.Text: Wonder what sorta design the girls are gonna come up with.

Text: クラウド　どんな水着　好き？

English.Text: Hey─what kinda swimsuit would you wanna see?

Text: なぜだ？

English.Text: Me?

Text: 参考にしようと思って

English.Text: Yes you. I'm curious!

Text: そうだな　機能性が高いものがいい

English.Text: Well, I prefer function over form, so durable...

Text:
撥水性が高く　水の抵抗を受け流し
水中での戦闘を想定した水着がいいな

English.Text: Maybe made with non-absorbent materials that allow for full range of motion─in case you need to fight underwater.

Text: あはははは　なるほどね～

English.Text: Okey dokey, then...

Text:
来たね
とっておきのデートコースを用意したよ

English.Text: There you are! Okay, I've got a great activity for you.

Text:
キミたち　まだチョコボレンタルの
会員になってないよね？

English.Text: Before that, though, I need to add your information to the system.

Text: じゃあ　まずはこれを

English.Text: Here, take this.

Text: これで　チョコボを自由に使えるよ

English.Text: It'll let you rent a chocobo whenever.

Text: 名前はキュマちゃん　よろしくね

English.Text: That's Kyma. Take good care of her.

Text:
ふたりには　この子に乗って
クラムシェルビーチを遊覧してもらいます

English.Text: So the idea is to ride Kyma here and enjoy a romantic stroll along the beach.

Text: クエ！

English.Text: Kweh!

Text: かわいい～！

English.Text: Aw!

Text:
ただ目的もなく散歩するのもなんだから
貝殻をとってきてもらおうかな

English.Text: But that on its own sounds like a huge yawnfest, so try hunting for shells while you're at it.

Text:
せっかくだし
できるだけ　大きいものがいいな

English.Text: How about you bring me the largest one you can find? Sound good?

Text: ボクは　ここで待っているから

English.Text: I'll be chillin' back here.

Text:
ふたりで　ステキな思い出を作って
貝殻といっしょに届けてね

English.Text: So you two run along and have yourselves one "shell" of a time!

Text:
クラムシェルビーチに行ってみて
ステキな貝殻を　楽しみにしているよ

English.Text: What're you still doing here? Get down to the beach and see what kinda shells you can find.

Text: 海岸デートを楽しんできて

English.Text: Don't forget to have fun, okay?

Text:
クラムシェルビーチには行った？
チョコボに乗って　貝殻をとってきてね

English.Text: Have you been down to that beach yet? Ride Kyma over there, and see if you can find some shells.

Text: できるだけ　大きなやつを期待してるよ

English.Text: Just bring back the biggest one you can find.

Text:
チョコボデートなんて
わたし　はじめて！

English.Text: I dunno about you, but this is definitely a first for me.

Text: 何度か乗っただろ

English.Text: You've ridden them before.

Text: それとこれは　べつ

English.Text: I'm not talking about the chocobos.

Text: たしかに　貝殻を探すのは初めてだな

English.Text: Oh... You meant the shells, right?

Text: はぐらかした

English.Text: Right...

Text: もしかして　緊張してる？

English.Text: Wait a second... Are you nervous?

Text: まさか　楽な仕事だ

English.Text: About what? Easiest job I've ever had.

Text: 緊張してる～！

English.Text: The merc's nervous!

Text: 貝殻があるのって　このあたりかな

English.Text: We should be able to find some good shells around here.

Text: そのまえに　掃除が必要だ

English.Text: But first, we clean up the trash.

Text: さて　貝殻探しといきますか

English.Text: Alright, seashells. Ready or not, here we come!

Text: まずは　チョコボに乗らないとな

English.Text: Let's saddle up first, then search.

Text: ステキな思い出　作らないとね

English.Text: Sounds good. Back on the birds we go!

Text: さて　貝殻探しといきますか

English.Text: You ready to dig around for those seashells, Cloud?

Text: まずは　チョコボに乗らないとな

English.Text: Let's saddle up first, then search.

Text: ありゃ　罰ゲーム？

English.Text: Well, that's not what we wanted!

Text: そのようだ

English.Text: No, it ain't!

Text: さて　貝殻探しといきますか

English.Text: Okay! Let's get back to it, shall we?

Text: う～ん　失敗

English.Text: That's another "Nope."

Text: ありゃ　ハズレ？

English.Text: Next time, for sure!

Text: ちいさくて　可愛らしいね

English.Text: It's so teeny-tiny!

Text: 面白いかたち　大きさもまずまず

English.Text: Nice, a conch! Decent size one too.

Text: うわ　おっきい　いいねいいね～！

English.Text: Whoa, I don't think I've ever seen a shell this big before!

Text:
二枚貝の片割れを持っている兵士が
戦場には　大勢いたんだ

English.Text: You know, a lotta troopers take half a shell with 'em when they head out on missions.

Text:
家族や恋人と持ち合いっこするんだよね
ロマンチックだよね～

English.Text: I know where this is going! It's meant to be a keepsake for their partner, right? A symbol of their undying love!

Text:
その貝殻をだれかに見せると
それは　死の予兆に変わる

English.Text: And an omen of death for the trooper if anyone else sees either one, some people say...

Text: ええ～　そんな話？

English.Text: Oh... That took a turn.

Text:
ねえ　この貝
耳にあてると　波の音がする

English.Text: Y'know, you can hear the ocean if you put this seashell right up against your ear.

Text: 反響音だ

English.Text: That's a myth.

Text: クラウドも聞いてみる？　はい！

English.Text: Oh, just try it, you spoilsport.

Text: 俺は　べつに

English.Text: I'm good.

Text: はい！

English.Text: Here.

Text: ざざ～　ざざ～　ざぶ～ん

English.Text: Pwsh, bwoo... Caw caw!

Text: 静かにしてくれ

English.Text: Keep it down, birdie.

Text:
貝殻が大きいから　中身もたっぷりだね
食べごたえありそう

English.Text: Hmm, if these things are all this size, I bet the suckers who live in 'em would make for good eatin'.

Text: 味は　どうだろうな

English.Text: Wonder how they taste.

Text:
そうだね
でもクラウド　味　気にしなさそう

English.Text: We could ask a local, but you don't strike me as the type to care all that much.

Text: まずくても　文句を言わないだけだ

English.Text: I don't. Food's food.

Text: ふ～ん

English.Text: Uh-oh...

Text:
あっ　聞いたことある
そういう人　ある日とつぜん爆発するって

English.Text: Don't you know what happens to people who say they don't care what their food tastes like? They spontaneously combust.

Text: エアリス　これはなんの話だ

English.Text: You're...screwing with me, right?

Text: もう　慣れて！

English.Text: I guess we'll see, won't we?

Text:
ふう　かなり集まったね
そろそろ　戻ろっか

English.Text: Whew! I think that should just about do it. Okay, ready to go?

Text: 満足したか？

English.Text: Are you sure?

Text:
その言い方　なんかズルい
クラウドこそ　満足した？

English.Text: Really─leaving the decision to me? What about you, Cloud? Are you sure?

Text:
嘘でもいいから
『まだ　もっと一緒にいたい』って答えなくちゃ

English.Text: This is the part where you're supposed to blurt out "I don't wanna go back! I wanna stay here with you!"

Text: それが　つぎに繋がるの

English.Text: This date's DOA otherwise.

Text: 俺を　困らせようとしているのか

English.Text: Okay, now you're just bein' mean.

Text: そういうわけじゃないけど

English.Text: I'm not trying to be mean, I...

Text: ごめん……

English.Text: Sorry.

Text:
おかえり
さて　どんな貝殻を集めてきたのかな？

English.Text:
Welcome back, you two.
So! Happen to find any neat shells out there?

Text: チョコボデートは楽しかった？

English.Text: How was the beach? Romantic?

Text: どの貝殻を渡しますか？

English.Text: Which of the shells will you hand over?

Text: 二枚貝を渡す

English.Text: The scallop shell.

Text: 巻貝を渡す

English.Text: The conch.

Text: 巨大な貝殻を渡す

English.Text: The gigantopod shell.

Text: 渡さない

English.Text: None.

Text: うん？　そんな貝殻ないけど

English.Text: But...you don't have a shell like that.

Text: ふふ　まだデートしたりないかい？

English.Text: Don't want your date to end, huh?

Text: へえ　可愛らしい二枚貝だね

English.Text: Aw! That's a cute little clam shell.

Text: 恋人同士が持つのに　ぴったり！

English.Text: Two halves of a whole─like all good couples!

Text: きれいに巻きあげられた螺旋か

English.Text: Oh! I like the spiral on that.

Text: 耳を寄せあって　波の音　聞いてみた？

English.Text: You try holding it up to your ear to hear the ocean waves?

Text: あっ　忘れてた

English.Text: Oh no! I forgot!

Text: こっ　これは……

English.Text: Whoa...

Text: すごいでしょ

English.Text: Huge, right?

Text: 博物館とかに飾ったほうがよさそう

English.Text: Dang. That thing belongs in a museum or something!

Text:
女性を笑顔にするのは　貝殻か思い出か
あるいは　その両方か……

English.Text: I can't help but wonder what is making her smile from ear to ear like that. Is it the shells, or...?

Text: うん　おかげで新作水着のモチーフが決まったよ

English.Text: Aha, I've got it! Inspiration has finally struck!

Text: ボクは　店に戻るね

English.Text: I know what to make!

Text:
あとで　ビーチのイベント会場まで来てよ
水着の発表会を開くから

English.Text:
But! Before I go─swing by the fashion showcase.
We want you front row center!

Text: それじゃあ　また

English.Text: See ya there!

Text: 今度は　ふたり乗りしてみる？　チョコボ

English.Text: Next time we need a chocobo, I say we ride double.

Text: スピードが落ちる

English.Text: And slow down the bird?

Text: ゆっくり景色見るのも　いいと思うけどな～

English.Text: Which would make it that much easier to take in all the scenery.

Text: 前はゆずれない

English.Text: I'm still steering.

Text: いいよ　じゃあ　おじゃましま～す

English.Text: Oh, fine. If you've got to be the man up front...

Text: 狙った相手を撃ち抜くなら　この水着で決まり

English.Text:
Wanna shoot your shot?
This swimsuit's got perfect aim.

Text: 情熱的な水着で　恋のレースを駆け抜けてみよっか

English.Text: Love might be a game, but you'll never lose in this winning ensemble!

Text:
オシャレして　ステキな思い出
拾いに行ってみませんか？

English.Text:
Wanna land a big catch?
With this look, it'll be hook, line, and sinker!

Text:
諸君　水着が似合う
美しい肉体が欲しくないか！

English.Text: My friends! Who among you doesn't ache for that perfect swimsuit physique!?

Text:
そんなあなたは
ミッドガルのジム『ダンダンダン』へ！

English.Text: You wanna get ripped? You want a hot bod!? Then you better train with the best of the best!

Text:
さあ　ごいっしょに
マッスル・ハーモニー！

MetaData.ACTOR: ゼン・ワン＆サン・トー

English.Text: So come join our gym, and muscle maximize!

Text: 見にきてくれたんだね！

English.Text: I'm so glad you came!

Text:
どうだい？
キミたちのデートが生み出した新作水着は

English.Text:
So? What'd you think of the show?
You were the inspo, after all!

Text:
とってもステキ！
でも　わたしたち楽しんだ……だけだよね

English.Text: I absolutely loved it! But the two of us didn't do anything "inspo"-worthy. We just had fun.

Text:
コスタを楽しんでる人を見ると
インスピレーションがわくんだよ！

English.Text: That's what we wanted! Happy couples get us inspired and fired up!

Text:
コスタ・デル・ソルは太陽の楽園
みんな　ステキな思い出を作って帰っていく

English.Text: Exactly! This place is more than just a vacay spot─it's a paradise where people come to create lifelong memories!

Text: その思い出を彩るのが　私たちの役目

English.Text: And making sure they do is what we do best.

Text:
だから　これからも
コスタのマリンブルーな海と

English.Text: So next time you swing by, promise to frolic in the waters...

Text: イターナルな空と！

English.Text: Bask in the sun...

Text: シャイニングな砂浜を　思う存分楽しんでね

English.Text: Enjoy our town to its fullest, and leave with a smile!

Text: そこにいるのは　クラウドくんじゃないか？

English.Text: Do my eyes deceive me? Is that Cloud?

Text: あっ　ウォール・マーケットのジムのひと！

English.Text: Oh, hey! You trade the city for the beach too?

Text: どうしてここに？

English.Text: What're you doin' here?

Text: ジムのみんなと　マッスル合宿に来ていてね

English.Text: Relaxing, really. We're on our yearly beach retreat.

Text:
毎年ここで　新しいコスチュームを
作ってもらってるんだよ

English.Text: And commissioning this year's new singlets from these talented young women.

Text:
そうだ　ねえ　あとで合宿場に顔を出してくれよ
なんでも屋に頼みたいことがあるんだ

English.Text: Oh, right─that reminds me... Stop by the training facility when you have a moment. We're in need of your particular skills.

Text: 考えておく

English.Text: Okay...

Text: 新作水着は　キューピットって名前にするわ

English.Text: We should call our new design the Romantico!

Text: 来シーズンは　カップルが増えるわよ

English.Text: I'm expecting lots of lovebirds next season.

Text: 次は動物用の水着も作ってみようかな

English.Text: I wonder if there's a market for doggy swimsuits.

Text: あの赤いワンちゃんにモデルをお願いできる？

English.Text: Do you think your furry friend would mind modeling for me?

Text: おかげさまで　評判は上々だよ

English.Text: People are going crazy for the new designs.

Text: あとは量産体制を整えないと

English.Text: I just hope we can make enough to meet the demand!

Text: あら　またデートに来たの？

English.Text: Well, well. Back on another date?

Text: 射的の腕　なまってない？

English.Text: I hope you haven't lost your touch.

Text: 赤いワンちゃん　毛だらけで暑くないの？

English.Text: Your pet must feel like he's in an oven with all that fur.

Text: 真っ赤な毛がはえた水着って　新しくない？

English.Text: Red fur could make for a fun swimsuit trim...

Text: 次の水着イベントは　モデルで出てみないか

English.Text: We'd love to have you as a model in our next fashion show.

Text: キミにピッタリな水着を作ってみせるよ

English.Text: I'll stitch the perfect suit just for you!

Text:
ミッドガル進出のために
神羅にコネを作りたかったけど

English.Text: I was hoping to make some connections at Shinra─help get our foot in the door.

Text: それどころじゃないかもね

English.Text: But maybe now's not the time...

Text:
どんな状況になっても
私たちは　水着を作り続けるわよ

English.Text: No matter what's going on in the world, we're still committed to our craft.

Text: ウータイの水着って　どんな感じなんだろ

English.Text: Wonder what kinda swimsuits they wear in Wutai.

Text: シノビをイメージした水着も作ってみたいな

English.Text: What about a ninja-kini? That could be cute, right?

Text:
ウータイの放送があってから
空気がすこし　重くなった気がするよ

English.Text: Things've felt pretty doom-and-gloomy around here ever since that broadcast out of Wutai.

Text:
平和じゃないとバケーションも楽しめないからね
戦争なんてカンベンしてほしいよ

English.Text: Hard to enjoy a vacation with the threat of war looming over you... Hard to enjoy much of anything, really.

Text: 合宿場で待っているよ

English.Text: I'll see you at the training facility.

Text:
新コスチュームは　どうだい？
とても動きやすいんだよ

English.Text: How do you like our new singlets? They're perfectly tailored to our dimensions.

Text:
おお　よく来たね
クラウドくん　ティファくん

English.Text:
Ah, there you are.
Glad you could make it, Cloud, Tifa.

Text:
こうやって年にいちど　潮風と太陽を浴びて
筋肉に磨きをかける合宿をしてるんだ

English.Text: Once a year, we take a retreat to enjoy the sun and sea breeze. Nothing like getting some gains in the great outdoors.

Text: どうだい　ウズウズするかい？

English.Text: Whaddya say? Care to sweat with us?

Text:
はい　実は最近
トレーニングできてなくて

English.Text:
I think I would.
I haven't done a proper workout in forever.

Text:
ティファくんなら　いつでも大歓迎だよ
好きに鍛えていってくれたまえ

English.Text: Well, we'll happily help you both become your best selves. Train with us as long as you like!

Text:
本当ですか？
ぜひ　お願いします！

English.Text: You mean it? Well, I might just take you up on that!

Text:
クラウドくん
筋トレに大事なものがなにか　わかるかい？

English.Text: Here's a question for you, Cloud. What would you say is the key to a good workout?

Text: 筋トレに大事なものがなにか　わかるかい？

English.Text: "What would you say is the key to a good workout?"

Text: トレーニング器具

English.Text: Training equipment.

Text: 食事

English.Text: A post-workout meal.

Text: 気持ち

English.Text: An unwavering resolve for gains.

Text:
そのとおり　自重での筋トレには限界がある
筋肉を大きくするなら　器具の負荷が効果的だよね

English.Text: Exactly. Body weight exercises will only take you so far. If you want to get really jacked, you'll need the resistance only equipment can provide.

Text: ただ　おかげさまで器具はそろってるんだ

English.Text: And as luck would have it, we've got a full assortment right here.

Text:
そのとおり
大事なのはスクラップ＆ビルド！

English.Text: Exactly. Can't expect to bulk up without the building blocks.

Text:
筋トレでいじめ抜いた後に良い食事をとることで
より良い筋肉ができるんだ

English.Text: Treat your muscles to a nice post-workout meal, and they'll reward you with even bigger gains.

Text:
あはは　そうだね
何事も気持ちが大事だよね

English.Text: Hah. Fair enough. The heart is the strongest muscle.

Text:
でも　そこは心配していないよ
ボクたちの筋トレにかける情熱は本物さ

English.Text: But I'm not too concerned about that. As you know, our passion for getting pumped up is second to none.

Text: それじゃ　本題に入ろうか

English.Text: Now let's get down to business, shall we?

Text: 頼みというのは　ほかでもない

English.Text: The reason I wanted you to stop by?

Text:
合宿場のまわりで目撃されたモンスターを
退治してもらいたいんだ

English.Text: Monsters have been spotted skulking around the facility, and I want them gone.

Text: いいだろう　わかった

English.Text: Sure. Should be easy enough.

Text: ありがとう

English.Text: Splendid.

Text:
安心してトレーニングができる環境というのも
筋トレには大事だからね　助かるよ

English.Text: We can't train our bodies unless our minds are at ease, so you'll be doing all of us muscleheads a big favor.

Text: さあ　さっさと倒しちゃお！

English.Text: Let's get out there and kick some ass!

Text: 楽しそうだな

English.Text: Someone's excited.

Text:
そうだね　体を動かしたいって思ってたから
嬉しくって

English.Text: Well, yeah. Wanted an excuse to work up a sweat, and now I've got one.

Text: 子供の頃とは　別人だ

English.Text: Wonder what little Tifa would say.

Text: どんな子だと思ってたの？

English.Text: I think she'd be pretty proud.

Text: やっぱりシンプルに　ステーキかな

English.Text: Can't really go wrong with steak, I guess.

Text: どうした？

English.Text: What?

Text:
ああ　ごめん　筋トレのあとなら
どんな料理がいいかなって考えてた

English.Text: Huh? Oh, sorry. Just some mental meal prep. The ideal post-workout dish.

Text:
セブンスヘブンのメニューは
ティファが考えたのか

English.Text: So you were the one behind Seventh Heaven's menu?

Text: 前のオーナーからの引き継ぎと　半々くらい

English.Text: Half was a holdover from the old owner. The better half was mine.

Text: もっと食べておけばよかった

English.Text: Shoulda ate there more.

Text: うん　食べてほしかったな

English.Text: Yeah... You snooze, you lose.

Text: ねえ　クラウドは好き嫌いってある？

English.Text: Hey, Cloud. Would you say you're a picky eater?

Text:
いや　ないな
軍では許されない

English.Text: SOLDIERs can't be choosers. We ate what we were fed.

Text: 実は私　結構あったんだ

Like a man who's killed his fair share of fiends,
I suppose.

Text: う～ん　戦う青年のニオイかな

English.Text:
Like...a guy who's seen his fair share of battles,
I guess.

Text: あまり　良さそうじゃないな

English.Text: Like blood and shit, then.

Text: 気にするな　私にしかわからない

English.Text: Not literal "shit," no...

Text: 気にしない　気にしない

English.Text: I mean, I wouldn't go that far...

Text: クラウド　覚えているか？

English.Text: Now's the time for any unfinished business.

Text:
クラウド
仕事が途中だ　続けるぞ

English.Text: If I may... Don't forget we have unfinished business.

Text: クラウド　覚えてる？

English.Text: They're really makin' us work for it. Let's go!

Text: クラウド　追跡の途中だったよね

English.Text: Cloud, we were tracking some black robe, right?

Text: ニオイは　この先へ続いているようだ

English.Text: I believe I've picked up their scent.

Text: ニオイの追跡を再開する

English.Text: It's time we resumed our search.

Text: ニオイは　こっちみたい

English.Text: Think they're this way.

Text: ニオイはバッチリ　オイラにまかせて！

English.Text: Okay, got their scent. I'll take it from here.

Text:
犯人のニオイは
あそこに続いているようだが……まずいな

English.Text:
Their scent seems to lead straight ahead, but...
Oh, that's not good.

Text:
犯人は　あそこへ向かったみたいなんだけど
困ったなあ

English.Text:
Well, their scent leads straight there, but...
Ah man, why now?

Text: どうした？

English.Text: What?

Text: いや　ひとまず向かおう

English.Text: Nothing... Let's continue.

Text: ううん　とにかく行ってみよ

English.Text: It's nothing... Let's just check it out.

Text: 来るぞ！

English.Text: Ready!?

Text: 強敵のニオイだよ！

English.Text: Smells like trouble, guys!

Text: うん　どうしたの？

English.Text: Oh, hello there!

Text: ニオイが違う　この男は犯人ではない

English.Text:
Different scent.
He has nothing to do with the kidnapping.

Text: この人からは　犯人のニオイはしないよ

English.Text: Definitely not a kidnapper. My nose can tell.

Text: もしかして　お腹が空いてる？

English.Text: Aw...you must be hungry, huh?

Text: 残念　あげないよ

English.Text: Sorry, but this is people food.

Text: うそうそ　すこしだけだよ？

English.Text: Whoa, easy there. I can spare a bite!

Text: 黒いマントを着た男を見なかったか？

English.Text: See a guy in a black robe come through?

Text:
う～ん　そういえばそんな格好をしたやつが
チョコボ車で洞窟のほうへ行くのを見たな

English.Text: Hm, now that you mention it... There was this one hooded fella. With a chocobo carriage─headed toward a cave nearby.

Text:
コスタでバカンスより　こうやって
ひとりでキャンプのほうが好きなんだ

English.Text: I'd rather relax in the great outdoors than some hoity-toity beach resort.

Text:
よし　いい感じに焼けてきたな
もうあげないよ

English.Text: Now this is what I call a perfectly cooked slab of meat...! Oh no─you already got your bit.

Text:
実は　私の鼻にも
ひとつだけ弱点がある

English.Text:
Though I am a skilled tracker,
I have one terrible weakness.

Text: あのね　オイラの鼻なんだけど

English.Text:
There's, uh, something you should
know about me and my nose.

Text: なんだ

English.Text: What?

Text: 食欲に負ける

English.Text: My appetite.

Text: 食べ物のニオイに　すっごく弱いんだよね

English.Text:
Whenever I catch a whiff of food,
it's all I can think about.

Text:
いまもまだ　漂う肉のかおりに引っ張られている
しばらく私の鼻には期待しないでくれ

English.Text:
With this overpowering aroma of meat in the air,
I don't think I'll be able to focus on the kidnapper's scent.

Text:
いまも　お肉のニオイで頭がいっぱい
しばらくオイラの鼻には期待しないで

English.Text: And since I can't get the smell of meat outta my nostrils, I...I don't think I'm gonna be a ton of help right now.

Text: 笑ったな

English.Text: I heard that.

Text: 笑った？

English.Text: Hey!

Text: レッドをまくには肉を焼けか

English.Text:
Grilled meat is all it takes to throw
you off your game?

Text: ナナキから逃げる時は肉を焼こう

English.Text:
Grilled meat is all it takes to throw
you off your game?

Text: クエックエ～！

English.Text: Kweh! Kweh!

Text: クエクエッ　クエ～！

English.Text: Kweh kweh! Kwehhh!

Text: クラウド　見ろ

English.Text: Cloud, look.

Text: クラウド　見て

English.Text: Cloud, look.

Text: 誘拐犯を探そう

English.Text: They gotta be close.

Text: シロンにもらったライトを使ってみてはどうだ

English.Text: Time to put the doctor's light to use.

Text: シロン先生にもらったライトを使ってみたら？

English.Text: Maybe we oughta try the light Doc Sheiran gave us!

Text: 黒マントを見つけたとして　犯人はどうする？

English.Text:
Once we've found our man,
what should we do with his captor?

Text:
黒マント　いるかなあ？
犯人もいっしょかな

English.Text:
So if we find our guy...
whadda you wanna do about the culprit?

Text:
黒マントを連れ戻せ　それがシロンの依頼だ
犯人のことは　なにも言っていなかった

English.Text:
Well, Sheiran asked us to rescue his patient.
He didn't say anything about how we should deal with the kidnapper.

Text: やるか

English.Text: You mean...?

Text: どうする？

English.Text: You mean...?

Text: 犯人の出方を見て　決めよう

English.Text: We'll figure it out later.

Text: 承知した

English.Text: Understood.

Text: りょーかい！

English.Text: Copy.

Text: 犯人の根城だ　留守のようだな

English.Text: This is the kidnapper's camp. No sign of them...

Text: 犯人のすみかみたいだね　いないけど

English.Text: Place reeks of kidnapper. No sign of 'em, though.

Text: どうする　待つか？

English.Text: So? Do we wait?

Text: 戻ってくるまで　どこかに隠れて待つ？

English.Text: Could hide till they get back─catch 'em by surprise?

Text: 助けて！

English.Text: Help!

Text:
わたしたち　誘拐されて
監禁されてるの

English.Text:
Some crazy bastard kidnapped us
and stuck us in this cave.

Text: うう……ああ……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Text: うう……ああ……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Text: うう……うう……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Text: うう……うう……

English.Text: Urg...ah... Hrn...

Text: 彼女たちをどうしますか？

English.Text: What will you do?

Text: 助ける

English.Text: Help them.

Text: 犯人について尋ねる

English.Text: Question them about the kidnapper.

Text: 疑う

English.Text: Mention that something seems off.

Text:
ありがとうございます
本当に助かります

English.Text:
Oh, thank you so much!
What ever would we have done without you...

Text: あなたがマヌケで

English.Text: you shit-for-brains.

Text: わかりません　わたし必死に逃げてきて

English.Text:
Huh? Why would we know anything?
We were too freaked out to even look at him.

Text: もしかしたら　すごく近くにいたりして

English.Text: The kidnapper could be anywhere...or anyone.

Text:
えっ　どういうことですか
わたし？　この黒マント？

English.Text:
Excuse me? I'm suspicious?
Or the robed guy? Who?

Text:
このニオイ
クラウド　そいつらが犯人だ！

English.Text: This smell... Cloud. It's them!

Text:
このニオイ
クラウド　そいつらが犯人だよ！

English.Text:
This smell...
Cloud─they're the ones we're looking for!

Text: バレちまったか

English.Text: Aw, boo.

Text: この変装を見破るなんて　賢いワンちゃんね

English.Text: Aren't you a clever little puppy, sniffing out the truth.

Text: 誘拐した黒マントは　どこだ？

English.Text: Okay. Where is he?

Text: 教えるわけないだろ

English.Text: Think we'd just tell you?

Text:
俺たちを誰だと思ってる
泣く子も黙る　クレイジーカップル

English.Text:
We're not your average criminals, kid.
In fact, we're the world's greatest double act!

Text: エリー　ア～ンド！

English.Text: Ellie the Elusive!

Text: バロウ様だぞ

English.Text: Barry the Brash!

Text:
うふふ　あなたを誘拐したら
身代金はいくらかしら

English.Text: I wonder what your friends would've paid for you. Guess we'll never know!

Text: へえ　やるじゃねえか

English.Text: Huh. That's some mighty fine killin'.

Text: 黒マントの男を返せ

English.Text: Give us the guy or you're next.

Text: バロウ　どうする？

English.Text: Ah, shit. Now what?

Text:
落ちつけ　エリー
黒マントは俺たちしかわからない所に隠してある

English.Text: Now? Now nothin'. Dog or no dog, they're never gonna be able to find that dude without us.

Text: もし返して欲しければ　金を……

English.Text: Hear that? Give us the money or we're gonna─

Text: って　ああ？

English.Text: Wha!?

Text: う……ああ……
おい　勝手に出てくんじゃねえ！

English.Text: Hey! We told you to stay put!

Text: ずっとおとなしかったのに　どうして

English.Text: I knew we should have tied him up!

Text: ああ……リユ……オン……

English.Text: Re...union...

Text: なんだ　知り合いか？

English.Text: What? Old buddy of yours?

Text: ねえバロウ　あいつの目　見た？

English.Text: Barry, look. The kid's eyes.

Text: ソルジャーだよ

English.Text: He's a SOLDIER.

Text:
どうりで強いはずだぜ
でも　聞いたぞ

English.Text: No wonder he wiped the floor with that monster... But time ain't on his side.

Text:
黒マントってのは　ソルジャーの成れの果て
劣化したソルジャーなんだろ？

English.Text: Even the strongest ones don't stay strong for long. Sooner or later, he'll wind up like all the rest─another mumbling, hooded freak.

Text: お仲間同士　仲良くしてな！

English.Text: Stay a while! Sure ya got lots to catch up on!

Text: バ～イ！

English.Text: Suck it, losers!

Text: 追うな　目的は果たした

English.Text: Let 'em go. We got our man.

Text: シロンのところへ帰ろう

English.Text: Let's take him back to Sheiran.

Text: ご苦労さん　助かったよ

English.Text: Glad to see our man's still alive.

Text: 多少傷が増えているが　問題ないだろう

English.Text:
And save for a few scrapes,
none the worse for the wear.

Text: ソルジャーが劣化するというのは　本当なのか？

English.Text: Is it true that SOLDIERs' cells degrade?

Text: ソルジャーが劣化するって　本当なの？

English.Text: Is SOLDIER degradation real?

Text: 正直なところ　わからん

English.Text: Believe me; if I knew, I'd tell ya.

Text:
ソルジャーの情報は
ほとんど公開されておらんし

English.Text:
But Shinra keeps a tight lid on
everything SOLDIER-related.

Text:
神羅以外の医師が　ソルジャーを診察する機会も
そうそうあるもんじゃない

English.Text: Only doctors with access to those secrets are the company's own. I certainly don't qualify.

Text: だからむしろ　わしのほうが聞きたい

English.Text:
If anyone here was gonna have answers,
it'd be you, son.

Text: 自覚や兆候があるのか？

English.Text: Been feelin' under the weather?

Text: 問題ない

English.Text: Not really.

Text: ソルジャーは比較的新しい技術だから

English.Text: The procedure you boys underwent was cutting edge.

Text:
加齢　経年によるソルジャーの変化は
神羅だって知らんだろう

English.Text: So much so, I doubt anyone in the company knew what the long-term effects might be...

Text: よって　どんな情報も貴重だ

English.Text: The more information we have, the better.

Text: やっぱり　血を採らしてくれんか

English.Text: So...change your mind about that blood sample?

Text: 断る

English.Text: No.

Text:
はははは　まあ
気長に待つことにするよ

English.Text: Hehehe! Well, one of these days I'll win ya over!

Text: さ～て　採血を再開するかな

English.Text: Well. I reckon I'd better get back to work.

Text:
黒マントは確実に増えている
いまのうちにデータだけでもそろえておかんとな

English.Text: Blood won't draw itself─and given the sheer number of those robes, collecting samples'll take time.

Text: 黒マントとソルジャーの血を比較したいんだがな

English.Text:
Still waiting on a SOLDIER sample,
if you catch my drift.

Text: ウータイの放送の話を聞いたよ

English.Text: That was a wild statement outta Wutai.

Text:
まあ　神羅に抗おうなんて気合いの入ったヤツは
この村にはおらんがな

English.Text: Gotta hand it to the SRC, though: no one around these parts has the guts to stand up to Shinra.

Text:
反神羅連絡会とかいう組織も
さすがに　この村は勧誘せんだろうな

English.Text: Probably why they haven't come around lookin' for new recruits. Know better than to waste their time with us.

Text: 狙われてるよ！

English.Text: It's aiming at you!

Text: 大丈夫だ　振りほどく

English.Text: Not for long, it isn't.

Text: いまがチャンスだ

English.Text: Go for it, guys!

Text: 一気に叩き込む！

English.Text: Let's finish this!

Text: このまま決めよう

English.Text: Let's go to work!

Text: 決めちゃおう！

English.Text: Take 'em out!

Text: 一気に決めるぞ

English.Text: Now's our chance!

Text: 好機を逃すな

English.Text: Time to bring it down.

Text: けっ　狙い撃ちだぜ！

English.Text:
That's right─
brought you down to our level!

Text: チャンスだよ！

English.Text: C'mon!

Text: 先手ひっしょ～！

English.Text: C'mere, ya big bully!

Text: おう　気をつけろ！

English.Text: What's this thing up to now?

Text: なにかくる！

English.Text: Careful!

Text: げっ　狙い撃ち？

English.Text: Ugly's workin' on something!

Text: おお　いけるぞこりゃ！

English.Text: Haha! Ya see that? Now we're cookin'!

Text: よし　いい感じ！

English.Text: Got it on the back foot now!

Text: おっひょ～　イイじゃんイイじゃん！

English.Text:
Jumbo fried chicken's
on the menu tonight, baby!

Text: やっべーぞ　やっべーぞ！

English.Text: What kind of bullshit─

Text: ウソでしょ？

English.Text: Dammit!

Text: あんなの　避けらんないよ！

English.Text: I'm not goin' anywhere near that!

Text: またかよ！

English.Text: Again with this?

Text: しつけえ野郎だ！

English.Text: Don't you know any other tricks!?

Text: また？

English.Text: Oh, come on!

Text: キリがないね

English.Text: Not this again...

Text: マジか～……

English.Text: Oh, now that's just cheating!

Text: もう　しつこいな～！

English.Text: Give it a rest already!

Text: うおお　ざまあみやがれ！

English.Text:
Hahaha!
Didn't see that one comin', didja!?

Text: 効いてるみたい！

English.Text: There we go.

Text: ど～よ　イイ感じ？

English.Text: Are we doin' good or are we doin' good?

Text:
魔晄炉建設の事故以来
行き場がねえんだ

English.Text: Ain't had no honest work since that damn reactor blew.

Text: 石炭の時代は　もう来ねえよなあ

English.Text: So much for the glory days... Coal ain't worth squat.

Text: おまえも人生詰んでるのか

English.Text: One day at a time, am I right?

Text: 村の調和を乱すなよ

English.Text: Don't go causin' trouble now.

Text:
どん詰まりの北コレルへ
ようこそ

English.Text: Welcome to nowheresville, North Corel.

Text:
バレットのやつ　いまさらよく
のこのこ戻ってきたな

English.Text: I heard tell Barret came waltzin' back into town after all this time.

Text: 炭坑の穴に突き落としてやろうか

English.Text: Now's our chance to dump his ass down a mine shaft!

Text: いや　魔晄炉のほうがいいだろ

English.Text: I do you one better─dump him in the reactor.

Text:
あそこから出てくるモンスターに
フタしねえと

English.Text: Use him as a plug to stop the monsters from pourin' out.

Text: 自業自得ってヤツよ

English.Text: That's what they call "poetic justice"!

Text:
おう　魔晄炉建設推進派のリーダー
バレット様に塞いでもらうのが筋だな

English.Text: Damn straight. He's the one who pushed for it in the first place. It's the least the sumbitch can do to make amends.

Text:
あいつが　魔晄炉を作ろうだなんて
言わなきゃ　オレたちの村は
静かなまま暮らせたんだ

English.Text: Mako is the future, my ass. More like the death of everything good in our lives.

Text: おう　ミーナって覚えてるか？

English.Text: Hey. You remember Myrna?

Text: バレットの嫁さんだろ

English.Text: Barret's wife, right?

Text: ありゃ　いい女だった

English.Text: And a mighty fine woman too.

Text:
ああ　あいつには
もったいねえくらいのな

English.Text: Hear, hear. Better than that bastard deserved.

Text:
こんな姿になっちまって
またいっしょに働きたいぜ　相棒

English.Text: Look at you─all in pieces. Sure wish we could go to work again, like the good ol' days.

Text:
ガタゴトガタコト
お山を行くよ～ってな

English.Text: Chugga chugga choo choo, chugga chugga choo choo, o'er the hills we gooo... Like that.

Text:
おまえが出してた音が
なつかしいぜ

English.Text: What I wouldn't give to hear your whistle blow.

Text:
ガキは気楽でいいな
俺も戻りてえよ

English.Text: Look at 'em. Not a care in the world. I envy that.

Text:
あの頃　列車がひっきりなしに走って
大人はみんな忙しそうに働いて

English.Text: Me, I envy the folks who got to work when the trains ran round the clock and there were more jobs than bodies to fill 'em.

Text: 毎日　明日が来るのが楽しみだったよな

English.Text: Used to be the future was full of promise...

Text:
ガキの頃
大人は汗と炭まみれで真っ黒で
かっこよかったよな

English.Text: I looked up to the adults comin' home caked in soot and sweat after a hard day's work. Don't see that no more, though.

Text:
いまのガキどもは
昼間から飲んでる俺たちを
どう思ってんだろうな

English.Text: Gotta wonder what the youngins think of us. Sittin' around, drinkin' the day away...

Text:
なんとも思ってないだろ
こんな大人しか知らねえんだから

English.Text: Doubt they think much anything about it. They've never known nothing else.

Text:
神羅の生活保護じゃ　ぜんぜん足りねえ
野垂れ死ねってことかね

English.Text: Shinra 'spects us to live off the scraps they toss our way? May as well tell us to go die in a ditch.

Text:
あんたが　働きもせず
酒ばっか飲むからだ

English.Text: That's 'cause you spend your time drinkin' 'stead of lookin' for honest work.

Text: 神羅はよくやってくれてるほうだよ

English.Text: Shinra'll take care of you if you pull your weight.

Text: 無茶しなきゃ　なんとかなるし

English.Text: Buckle down and your day will come.

Text:
だからみんな昼間から
道端でゴロゴロしてんだ

English.Text: Exactly. You don't do your bit, you ain't owed shit.

Text:
へたに働けば
なんももらえなくなるからな

English.Text: It's your own damn fault for pissin' away the day bitchin' and moanin'.

Text:
てめえ　オレの酒
飲みやがったな！

English.Text: Where do you get off, drinkin' all my booze!?

Text:
うっせえ！
細かいことでガタガタぬかすな

English.Text: Aw, shut up. I can drink whatever the hell I want!

Text: どうせ　俺が恵んでやった酒だろうが！

English.Text: I'm the one who paid for it in the first place!

Text: はあ　お腹すいた

English.Text: I could eat a chocobo...

Text: いっくぞ～！

English.Text: Gonna leave you in the dust!

Text: 楽勝だぜ

English.Text: This is nothin'!

Text: いっくよ～！

English.Text: Here I go!

Text: かんたん　かんたん

English.Text: Easy as ABC!

Text:
お兄さん
はやく出ていくほうがいいよ

English.Text: I wouldn't recommend stickin' around for long.

Text: やった～！

English.Text: Did you see that!?

Text: らっくしょ～！

English.Text: How do ya like that?

Text: できた～！

English.Text: Hah! I made it!

Text: 大成功！

English.Text: I could be a tightrope walker!

Text: ふん　遊べる場所はないわよ

English.Text: Ain't nothin' here for you.

Text: 騒ぎを起こさないでほしいわ

English.Text: We ain't gonna put up with any mischief.

Text: ここじゃ　よそ者は歓迎されないよ

English.Text: People round here don't take kindly to outsiders.

Text: ツウコウリョウよこせ～！

English.Text: You gotta pay the toll!

Text: １ギルくれ～

English.Text: One gil─pay up!

Text: なんか　くれよ～

English.Text: Give us somethin', wouldja?

Text: おこづかい　ほしい

English.Text: Got any gil for me? Huh? Huh?

Text: いらないもの　もらってあげる

English.Text: I'll take anything you don't want. Anything!

Text: おやつ　ちょうだい

English.Text: Got any candy?

Text: なんだ旅人か　めずらしいな

English.Text: Well I'll be. Not often we get visitors.

Text:
モンスターに襲われたって
助けねえぞ

English.Text: Don't expect us to come runnin' if a monster jumps ya.

Text:
北コレルじゃ　自分の身は
自分で守るのがルールだ

English.Text: In Corel, it's every man, woman, and child for themselves.

Text:
コレル山は　昔は静かな山だったが
いまじゃモンスターの巣窟だ

English.Text: Used to be this mountain was quiet as a dormouse─harmless as one, too. Fiends didn't bother us none.

Text:
ここも　いつ襲われるか
わかったもんじゃない

English.Text: Now they eye us like we're their next meal...

Text:
モンスターが襲ってきたら
真っ先に食われて
真っ先に楽になれるな

English.Text: Almost wish they'd get on with it already─put us outta our misery. This kind of livin' takes its toll on you...

Text:
魔晄炉なんて作らなきゃ
あたしの旦那はまだ生きてたのかもって
いまだに　ふと思っちまうんだ

English.Text: Not a day goes by I don't wonder, "Would my husband still be here if we hadn't let them build that damn reactor?"

Text:
楽して儲けようなんて
欲かいた罰かね

English.Text: Suppose we brought it on ourselves. Thinkin' we could have everything easy.

Text:
あたしが自警団なんてやってるのも
罪滅ぼしなのかもしれないね

English.Text: Maybe that's why I joined the watch. No more pretendin'─an honest life.

Text:
あいつのところに
はやく行ってやるのさ

English.Text: And a short one too. If I'm lucky.

Text: バカ言ってないで　命は大事にしなよ

English.Text: Don't you go talkin' that nonsense. Your life's a gift.

Text: なんだ　客か

English.Text: Huh. A customer.

Text: 見るなら買ってけよ

English.Text: No window-shoppin', y'hear?

Text: ふん……

English.Text: Hmph...

Text: じゃあな

English.Text: See ya...

Text: ひひひ　悪くねえマテリアだ

English.Text: Gotta say, not a bad selection.

Text: こいつは高くさばけそうだぜ

English.Text: Bet this one'll fetch a ton of gil.

Text:
店長おどして奪い取るだけか
楽勝だな

English.Text: And all's we gotta do is tighten the screws. Like takin' candy from a baby.

Text:
強盗にやられて廃業だなんて
ひでえ話だ

English.Text: What kinda dumbass'd rob a place that rarely gets customers?

Text: 店主は　元気にしてっかな

English.Text: I hope the owner's doing alright...

Text: とうとう廃業しちゃったのね

English.Text: Had to close up shop for good, huh?

Text:
強盗に入られたんだって
気の毒ね

English.Text: I heard they got their shit took. Damn shame, that.

Text:
遅い　遅すぎる
下見からの報告はまだか

English.Text: Something's wrong. Where the hell is he? Man shoulda been here hours ago.

Text:
あせるなって　店は逃げねえよ
計画立ててる時が楽しいんじゃねえか

English.Text: Easy now. Ain't like the shop's gonna up and walk away. This just gives us more time to plan.

Text:
ふん　マテリアの横流しのほうは
問題ないんだろうな

English.Text: And you sure you got a buyer who can pay good gil for this materia?

Text:
ああ　心配ない
ルートは確保した

English.Text: Yeah, no worries there. I know a guy.

Text: あとはブツさえ手に入りゃあ……

English.Text: All we gotta do is take what ain't ours.

Text:
なんだ　これは水だぜ
ホンモノは買えねえからな

English.Text: Whatchu lookin' at? It's water, case you're wonderin'. Can't afford to buy the real stuff.

Text:
頼まれても　やらねえぞ
買ってくれるなら考えるけどな

English.Text: Ain't givin' you none, if that's why you're starin'. Then again...everything's got its price.

Text: おまえのせいで仕事がねえんだ

English.Text: It's your fault we ain't got no work!

Text: さっさと出てけ！

English.Text: Get the hell outta here!

Text: 謝罪だけじゃ許されねえぞ

English.Text: Apologies ain't gonna cut it!

Text: お願い　家族を返してよ！

English.Text: Give me back my family, you monster!

Text: なにもかも奪われたのよ

English.Text: You stole everything from us!

Text:
どんな思いで
生きてきたと思ってるの！

English.Text: Do you have any idea what we've been through!?

Text: 文句ばっかじゃ腹が減るだけだ

English.Text: Whatever... Whinin' never got nobody nowhere.

Text: バレットに絡んでも仕方ねえ

English.Text: No point pickin' a fight now.

Text: 俺らにできることって　なんだろうな

English.Text: There's gotta be somethin' we can do to move forward.

Text:
私たち　神羅に
利用されただけなのかもね

English.Text: We were only ever tools to Shinra─to be used and thrown away.

Text: ここも　昔は良かったのよ

English.Text: I just...miss what we used to have.

Text:
魔晄炉がある暮らしに
夢を見ていたんだよね……

English.Text: We weren't askin' for much─just a little more...

Text:
ひいいっ　すまねえ
次はうまくやるから殴らないでくれ！

English.Text: Sorry! I'm sorry! I promise I'll do it right next time! Just don't hit me!

Text:
落ち着け　ボスはもういねえよ
誰もおまえをボコボコにはしねえ

English.Text: Hey, deep breaths. The boss ain't here. No one's gonna hurt you, promise.

Text: 急に昔のことを思い出すんだ

English.Text: I was...I was there.

Text:
冷や汗が止まらねえ
頭が真っ白になっちまう

English.Text: God, it just...felt so...real.

Text:
コレルプリズンは生き地獄だったんだ
無理もねえよ

English.Text: I understand. Believe me, I do. We'll get through it together.

Text:
ひと山当てたら　こんな陰気な村
さっさとおさらばしてやるんだ

English.Text: The second I strike it rich, I'm puttin' this godforsaken hellhole behind me.

Text:
おうよ　こんなところに居続けたら
骨の髄まで不幸がしみついちまう

English.Text: Yeah, no shit. This dump ain't even fit for wererats, let alone people. Can't wait to leave.

Text: さっさとしてくれよ

English.Text: Hurry it up, wouldja?

Text: 面倒だねえ

English.Text: You better buy something.

Text: まいど

English.Text: Thanks.

Text: 満足かい？

English.Text: You good now?

Text:
こんなの読むより
働いたほうがいいな

English.Text: If we ain't got work, may as well read, I suppose.

Text: 分厚いのなら　腕を鍛えられそうだ

English.Text: Bet the extra thick ones would make for good training weights.

Text: ちんぷんかんぷん……

English.Text: It's all gibberish to me.

Text: わあ～　きれいな表紙

English.Text: Wow... What a gorgeous cover.

Text:
腹が減ったら　むかし食った
うまいもんを思い出せば
腹いっぱいになれるぞ

English.Text: When you're hungry, remember something great you ate. Then you can eat the memory!

Text:
退屈したら　炭坑時代を思い出せば
仕事したつもりになれるぞ

English.Text: And when you're bored, remember the good ol' days. The coal and the gil and the glory!

Text:
ハッハッハ　俺はしあわせ！
いまがいちばん自由で豊かだぞ？

English.Text: Ahaha! They can't take your past from ya! And when you live in the past, you don't need no future!

Text: 買い物なんて　いいご身分で

English.Text: Look at moneybags here goin' shoppin'.

Text: 金あるなら恵んでくれよ

English.Text: Spread that wealth around, why don't ya?

Text: 見るからには　買うんだろうな

English.Text: I trust you ain't just window-shoppin'.

Text: いらっしゃい

English.Text: Welcome.

Text: どうも

English.Text: Bye.

Text: ありがとよ

English.Text: Thank you.

Text: かっこいいねえ　買えないけど

English.Text: That's some mighty fine stuff. Not that I can afford it...

Text: 物騒だから欲しいんだけどねえ

English.Text: Wouldn't need 'em if it weren't for the state of the world.

Text: 眺めるたびに　みじめになるわ

English.Text: Somehow just lookin' only makes me feel worse.

Text:
う～ん
高い　高すぎる

English.Text: Nah. Way too expensive.

Text:
あの鳥　炭坑で
空気チェックのために育ててた
ピヨ子だよな？

English.Text: Hey, isn't that one of the birds we raised to check for damps? Lil' Chirpie?

Text: 子連れなんて　大きくなったもんだ

English.Text: Ain't little no more. Got a chick of her own now even.

Text:
いっしょに炭坑に入ってたときは
ちっこかったのにな

English.Text: She used to be no bigger 'n' a chunk of coal back when she was in the tunnels with us.

Text:
ちっこいピヨ子が
いちばん優秀だったよな

English.Text: Couldn't've asked for a better partner than lil' Chirpie.

Text: 何度も助けられたよ

English.Text: We'd be long dead without 'er.

Text:
ビビりだから
ちょっと空気が薄くなると
すぐ大騒ぎしてくれるんだよな

English.Text: She was a jumpy little thing, wasn't she? Raised holy hell at the first whiff of gas.

Text:
おかげで　俺たちはまだ生きてる
ピヨ子さまさまだ

English.Text: That she did. And a lotta good folks are better off for it.

Text: ピヨ子の子供がいなくなったってよ

English.Text: Lil' Chirpie's chick's gone missing.

Text:
ピヨ子も砂漠を
探しまわってるんだろうな

English.Text: She's prob'ly lookin' all over the desert for him.

Text:
あいつは　俺たちの守り神だ
無事だといいがな

English.Text: Hope they're alright. Always feel safer when they're around...

Text: ピヨ子も子供も　無事だったってよ

English.Text: Lil' Chirpie brought her chick back home.

Text: ああ　よかった

English.Text: Well, that's a relief.

Text:
ビビりで　うまくモンスターから
隠れてたんだろう

English.Text: That sixth sense of hers prob'ly kept 'em safe.

Text:
村のガキどものアイドルだからな
探してくれたやつに感謝だ

English.Text: Oughta thank whoever found 'em. Kids would've been crushed if those birds were never seen again.

Text: うわ～　鳥さん親子？

English.Text: Is that the mommy? And is that the baby!?

Text: かわいいね～

English.Text: They're so cute!

Text: 名前　なんだろ？

English.Text: Did you guys give it a name yet?

Text: でっかい鳥は　お母さん？

English.Text: Is the super-big one really his mom?

Text: あの子　飼えるかな

English.Text: Think my mom would let me keep him?

Text: ピヨピヨ～！

English.Text: Chirp chirp chirp!

Text:
魔晄炉事故のせいで
うちの人も亡くなったの

English.Text: Been four years, and not a day goes by I don't think of my husband.

Text: 旦那の形見のこの銃は　私のお守り

English.Text: His old gun's the only thing I've got left to remember him by.

Text:
きっといまでも
私のそばに居てくれるの

English.Text: Makes me feel safe─like he's still here with me.

Text:
まいったな　車輪がイカれちまった
配給の食材を届けなきゃなんねえのに

English.Text: It's no use. Wheel's busted. How're we supposed to move all these rations now?

Text:
サカキの爺さんがいりゃ
修理を頼めるのにな

English.Text: If old man Sakaki was here, he'd have her up and rollin' in a flash.

Text: まあ　頼むにはひと苦労だが

English.Text: Not that you'd ever wanna rely on him...

Text:
サカキの爺さん
どんな道具も作っちまうし
大抵のもんは直せるから
ありがたいんだけどな

English.Text: Yeah, I hear ya. Could make any kinda tool you'd want─fix up just about anything─but, man, was he a pain to work with.

Text:
なにもしてねえのに怒鳴るから
ビビるよな

English.Text: Ain't that the truth. Always yellin' his head off about this or that.

Text: 留守だとホッとするけど　困るな

English.Text: Lot quieter without him, but─puts us up a creek.

Text: 旅からは　いつ帰ってくるんだろう

English.Text: Wonder when he'll come back from his "journey."

Text: あの時　ダインに賛成してればな

English.Text: Hahhh... If only we'd listened to Dyne back then.

Text:
ぜんぶ　バレットのせいさ
あいつが強引に押し切りやがったから

English.Text: It's Barret's fault. He wore everyone down till they had no choice but to follow his lead.

Text:
ダインのやつ
いまはアンダーソーサーにいるらしい

English.Text: I hear Dyne's been hangin' around the Dustbowl these days.

Text:
へえ　あいつも
ワルに転じちまったのか

English.Text: Oh yeah? So he's fallen in with that crowd too, has he...

Text: まあ　元気にやってりゃそれでいいさ

English.Text: Well. To each their own I guess.

Text:
生きてりゃ
いいことあるかもしれないしな

English.Text: I wouldn't give up on the man just yet.

Text:
この村には　神羅が最低限の生活物資を
届けてくれるんだよ

English.Text: Shinra throws us a bone every so often, y'know. Sends us supplies.

Text: むかし　魔晄炉建設事故があってね

English.Text: There was an accident at the reactor long ago, see.

Text: その事故の補償のつもりかもしれないが

English.Text: So it's their way of compensatin' us.

Text:
シロン先生が神羅に掛けあってくれて
どうにか補償を勝ち取ってくれたんだよ

English.Text: 'Cept Doc Sheiran had to raise hell to get us even that much. Dunno where we'd be without him.

Text:
シロン先生が食事の配給とかしてるのは
病人を減らして
楽したいからだって言ってたわ

English.Text: Doctor Sheiran's been distributing meals to the people in town. Says it's because he wants to keep them healthy and out of his clinic.

Text:
ここだけの話　配給のごはんに
お薬を入れてるの

English.Text: Just between us, though, he's actually been mixing supplements into the meals.

Text: お薬のおかげで　みんな健康なのよ

English.Text: And it's working. Folks are looking healthier than ever!

Text:
炭坑時代から
この診療所とシロン先生だけは変わらず
ここにありつづけてるんだ

English.Text: If there's one thing you can count on, it's Doctor Sheiran. He's been here since the old mining days.

Text:
コレル村の事件のとき　先生は
ここで仕事をしていて難を逃れたけど
村にいたご家族は亡くなられて

English.Text: The doc was here when everything went down in Corel. Unfortunately, his family wasn't. Terrible shame.

Text:
先生が村のために色々してくれるのは
家族を守れなかったことへの
罪滅ぼしなのかもな

English.Text: Them and all the others are probably why he works so hard. His way of making up for all the lives he couldn't save that day.

Text: 魔晄炉建設中に　ケガしてね

English.Text: Got myself injured while working on the reactor back in the day.

Text:
ここに運びこまれたときには
おったまげたよ

English.Text: Found myself here when I woke up. Wasn't none too happy about that.

Text:
もとは炭坑の診療所だったらしいけど
古めかしい設備しかなくて
不安になったもんだ

English.Text: This used to be a coal miners' clinic, see, and all the equipment was ancient as hell. Didn't trust it one bit. Reckoned I was done for.

Text: まあ　医療は機械がするもんじゃない

English.Text: But it's doctors who do the operatin', not their equipment.

Text:
わしが元気なのは
先生の腕がいいんだろうな

English.Text: And little did I know, I was in some of the best hands in the world.

Text:
先生に診てもらえば
たいていの病気は　すぐに治るのよ

English.Text: The doctor here always knows just how to treat my aches and pains. He's such a dear.

Text:
おかげで　あたしゃ
こんなにピンピンよ

English.Text: Why, I'm as spry as a spring chocobo thanks to him.

Text: 家にいたら　退屈で死んじまいそうでね

English.Text: If I stayed cooped up at home all the time, I'd die of boredom.

Text:
ここにくりゃ知り合いと会えるし
ありがたいよ

English.Text: But here I can see all my friends and acquaintances. It does an old lady good to get out and chew the fat.

Text:
まずい酒が
もっとまずくなっちまった

English.Text: Thanks, ya managed to make this taste worse.

Text:
謝罪の歌でも歌えよ
鉱山でよく歌ってたろ

English.Text: What─you gonna do some song an' dance 'bout how sorry you are?

Text:
おいおい
また魔晄炉でも建てるのか？

English.Text: Come to build us another reactor? First one was plenty!

Text:
あらあら
バレット様のお帰りだね

English.Text: Look who decided to come back home!

Text:
村を捨てて
あんたは気楽なもんねえ

English.Text: What "glorious dream" ya come peddlin' now?

Text: あたしの家族を返して！

English.Text: You took everything from me!

Text:
たくさん噛んでね
お腹いっぱいになるから

English.Text: Keep chewin', okay? It'll make you feel full.

Text:
あっ　ディオの
ヒゲキーホルダーの金具付けも
はじめることにしたんだ

English.Text: Oh, we got these keychains shaped like Dio's mustache now too. They're sure to sell.

Text:
うん　それも手伝う
不良品があったらもらいたいな

English.Text: I'll help with those too! Maybe if there's a broken one I can keep it?

Text: シロン先生の配給で～す！

English.Text: Get your free rations!

Text:
たっぷりあるので　慌てず
順序よく並んでください

English.Text: Doc Sheiran made sure there's plenty to go around, so don't worry.

Text: しっかり食べて　元気出しましょう

English.Text: Please line up in an orderly fashion!

Text:
星の民よ　いまこそ
星とつながり　星の叫びを聞け

English.Text: Children of the planet, hearken to our mother. Open your heart and heed her mournful cries!

Text:
儲け話　みなさんに
特別に教えちゃいます！

English.Text: Looking to make some quick gil? Then I have got some news for you, friends!

Text: マテリア投資なら必ず儲かります

English.Text: All you need to do is invest in materia!

Text:
まず　確実に高騰する新作マテリアを
安く大量に買い付け
マテリアの値があがったら
一気に売りさばく

English.Text: First, you buy up new orbs on the cheap: ones that are sure to prove valuable. Then, once their price skyrockets, you sell 'em for a huge profit!

Text:
投資額をドーンとあげれば
儲けもドーンとあがります～！

English.Text: Once you've made a tidy sum, you can invest in even more and start raking in the gil!

Text:
どうです　簡単でしょう？
いますぐ借金してでも始めるべきです

English.Text: Easy as pie, right? Anyone can do it! And if you need a little something to get started, I can help you out with a small loan.

Text:
すぐにもうかるから
返済も　すぐに終わります

English.Text: You'll be able to pay it back in no time flat!

Text:
コレルは　かつて多くの星の民が
星に帰られた地

English.Text: For she suffers as you do. She too weeps for what she has lost.

Text: お金なら　いつでもご用意しますよ

English.Text: Just say the word and I'll be more than happy to get you good folks set up.

Text: いいねえ！

English.Text: Count me in!

Text:
残された者は　悲しみ　迷い
憎しみに囚われている

English.Text: She knows your pain, your sadness, your grief. She knows your anger.

Text: だまされるな　オレ

English.Text: Don't fall for it.

Text: 返せなかったら　逃げりゃいいか

English.Text: Could always book it if I can't pay.

Text: マテリアなら安心だよな！

English.Text: Materia's sure to skyrocket.

Text: 『ドーン』か～！

English.Text: Time to rake it in!

Text: ふ～ん　すぐに返せるんだ

English.Text: Wow. Sounds like a cinch to pay off.

Text: 借りちゃおっかな～？

English.Text: Maybe I should get in on this.

Text: うんうん　儲かりそうね！

English.Text: Cushy life, here I come!

Text: 子供の将来のために……

English.Text: This money'll give my kids a chance...

Text: 投資って　なにするの？

English.Text: So how do we...invest?

Text: いまこそ　星を救うために行動せよ

English.Text: So join in her lament! Share in her rage!

Text:
身のうちにある星を見いだし
ともに響け

English.Text: Come! Raise your voice and join in our righteous chorus!

Text:
炭坑でも　給食があったな
体が資本だからって豪勢だったよ

English.Text: The lunches we got as miners were much better. Those were meals that put meat on your bones.

Text:
うまいメシだが　石炭まみれで
メシも真っ黒だったけどな

English.Text: Though I will say this much: I sure don't miss eatin' food seasoned with soot.

Text: 毎日　このごはん

English.Text: Same shit, different day.

Text:
おいしいのか　まずいのかも
もうわからないのよ

English.Text: Can't even tell anymore if it's good or bad. It's just food.

Text:
ううん……
おいしいって思いながら食べなきゃ
シロン先生に悪いわ

English.Text: No, no─shouldn't think like that. I should be thankful for all Doc Sheiran's done for us.
Ten, twenty, thirty...

Text:
ぜんぜん腹いっぱいにならない
オレの胃袋　穴でもあいてるのか

English.Text: I don't understand. How am I still hungry? Is there a hole in my stomach or something?

Text:
そう　星を救うことは
わが身を救うことにほかならぬ

English.Text: For our mother's sake, and for ours. For what we do for the planet, we do for ourselves.

Text: 休むなら　好きにしろ

English.Text: Take whatever beds're open.

Text: いいな　物を盗むなよ？

English.Text: No stealin' or you're out. Got that?

Text: さっさと出てけ

English.Text: It's time you moved on.

Text: ふん　ダニがおみやげだ

English.Text: Keep the bedbugs. They're on the house.

Text:
魔晄炉建設のときに村にきた
神羅のスカーレットさんが
忘れられないんだ

English.Text: Back when the reactor was being built, there was this Shinra exec: Scarlet. I'll never forget her.

Text:
真っ赤なドレスがすてきで
冷たく笑うのよ

English.Text: She wore these stunning red dresses, and the way she laughed...

Text:
それに　とっても
いいにおいがするんだよね

English.Text: Can still smell her perfume. Wish I knew what it was.

Text:
あの人の言うことなら
なんでも聞いちゃうかも

English.Text: I'd follow that princess to the ends of the world if she let me.

Text:
ぺっぺっ　ぺっ！
砂まじりの酒はここの名物だな

English.Text: Pff... Pff... Puh! Gotta love that dusting of sand on every drink.

Text:
砂漠がどんどん広がってる気がするけど
いつか世界が砂で覆われちまうのかもな

English.Text: Feels like this goddamn desert grows bigger every day. Maybe it'll swallow the whole world.

Text:
いつまで　この暮らしに
耐えるつもりですか？

English.Text: No one should ever have to live like this.

Text:
せっかくの才能を
埋もれたままにするのは罪です

English.Text: It hurts my soul to see your talents go to waste.

Text:
楽して稼げる
いい仕事を紹介しますよ
あなたなら　必ず成功できます

English.Text: Fortunately, we got a job that's right up your alley. Man of your ability'd be rollin' in gil before he knows it.

Text:
俺の才能を見抜くとは
あんたたち　見る目あるな！

English.Text: Haha! Well, it's clear you've both got eyes for skill.

Text: ぜひ　仕事を紹介してくれ

English.Text: Think I'll take you up on that offer.

Text: 仲間を　できるだけ集めてきてください

English.Text: Go and gather as many people as you can.

Text:
みなさんには　新商品を
試食していただきたいのです

English.Text: People with real discerning palates to taste-test food.

Text: 謝礼は弾みます

English.Text: Make it worth your while.

Text:
連れてきた人数に応じて
ボーナスをつけましょう

English.Text: You get a bonus dependin' on how many folks you bring in.

Text:
しかも　試食は食べ放題
お酒も飲み放題ですよ

English.Text: Whole thing's buffet style─unlimited food, drink. The works.

Text:
おお　金持ちのやることは
スケールが違うな

English.Text: We get all that? For free? Rich people're somethin' else.

Text:
友達も家族も親戚も
みーんな連れてくよ！

English.Text: You got a deal! I'll tell my friends, family─everybody!

Text:
ヘヘヘ　いいカモがひっかかった
今月のノルマ達成　ちょろいな

English.Text: Hahaha... Talk about easy marks. Guess I won't have to worry about meeting this month's quota.

Text:
困ってるヤツばっかだから
楽して稼げるって言えばすぐ釣れる

English.Text: Right? They're so desperate for gil that they'll believe any bullshit ya feed 'em.

Text:
もっと営業かけて　カモを集めよう
今月のＭＶＰをとってやる

English.Text: Keep 'em comin'. If we can haul in more suckers, we got a good chance at comin' out on top this month.

Text: おう　のしあがろうぜ！

English.Text: Yeah, we got this in the bag.

Text: もうプリズンで踏みつけられたくねえ

English.Text: No one'll be able to treat us like dirt now.

Text: 砂漠に出たって　いいことないぜ？

English.Text: Wouldn't recommend going out there, 'less you got a death wish.

Text: 暑さにやられて幻覚見るなよ？

English.Text: We ain't gonna save you if you get heatstroke.

Text:
あるかわからないお宝を探しに
砂漠をさまようなんて　絶対ゴメンだ

English.Text: Hell no. I ain't dyin' in the desert lookin' for treasure that might not exist.

Text:
ここでくすぶってたら
死んだも同然じゃねえか

English.Text: Way I see it, wastin' away here ain't no better.

Text:
いっそ死んだつもりで
探しに行こうぜ

English.Text: Least this way we got a shot at a better life!

Text:
お宝って　しゃべるゴブリンだの
動きまわるサボデンダーが
守ってるってやつだろ？

English.Text: The treasure. The one that's guarded by a talkin' goblin, dancin' cactuars, and other weird shit.

Text:
そんなの
暑さにやられて見た幻覚だよ

English.Text: Dumbass made that up definitely had heatstroke.

Text:
でも『サボテン大王』ってマンガにも
書かれてるって

English.Text: But there's a whole series about the Cactuar King!

Text: なあ　これは真実だよな！

English.Text: And comic books, they ain't never lie!

Text:
炭坑閉鎖のうわさを聞いて
廃棄物あさりに駆けつけたのが運のツキ

English.Text: Heard through the grapevine the mine was shuttin' down, so I spent every last gil I had to get here quick.

Text:
全財産をはたいてきたのになにもなくて
結局　ここに閉じこめられちまった

English.Text: Figured I could make a killing scavenging parts...only to find a big, fat load of nothing...

Text:
ああ　なつかしの故郷に帰りたい
でも先立つものがない

English.Text: So now I'm stuck here. Flat broke. Don't even have anything worth hawking to pay my way back home...

Text:
ボブは　ゴールドソーサーの
役者で大当たり

English.Text: Bob made it big as a performer in the Gold Saucer...

Text:
ブッチは　コスタで始めた
アイス屋が大当たり

English.Text: And Bruce has his ice cream shop in Costa del Sol...

Text:
ああ　いつかはオレだって
大当たりするさ

English.Text: I'll make it out too one of these days. I will.

Text: ガツーン　大当たり～！

English.Text: Going...going...gone!

Text: うわ～　はずした！

English.Text: Swing and a miss!

Text:
見晴らしがいいところで食えば
カスカスのメシも　すこしはマシになる

English.Text: Take it from me, even the foulest food'll taste halfway decent if you eat it somewhere nice.

Text:
ハハハ　これが
生活の知恵ってやつよ

English.Text: Hahaha... That's a little pearl o' wisdom I picked up.

Text: 最近　行方不明になるヤツらが多いな

English.Text: Been a lotta people up and vanishin' lately.

Text:
消えるのは
羽振りが良くなったヤツばかりって話だ

English.Text: And they always seem to poof right when things're lookin' up for 'em.

Text:
マジかよ　オレの親友も
なにも言わずにいなくなっちまったんだ

English.Text: That so? Y'know, I haven't seen or heard from this one friend in a while now...

Text:
あやしい商売に
手を出したんじゃないよな？

English.Text: Could be they got caught up in some shady business.

Text: 世の中　うまい話なんてないぜ

English.Text: If it sounds too good to be true, it is.

Text:
この村じゃあ　いいヤツはたいてい
悪いヤツだ　覚えとけ

English.Text: Shouldn't be too quick to trust friendly types, 'specially if they're "here to help."

Text: お……おう

English.Text: Guess so.

Text: 急いで　今日中にあと３００個！

English.Text: Pick up the pace. We need three hundred more.

Text:
ディオクッキーの
袋詰めしなきゃならないのよ

English.Text: And we have to pack up these Dio Cookies.

Text:
うん　ディオシール貼り
手伝うね

English.Text: Okay. I'll help put on the Dio stickers.

Text: やってやらあ！

English.Text: C'mon, bring it!

Text: やんのか　コラ！

English.Text: You gonna hit me or what!?

Text: まだまだ　もう１戦だ！

English.Text: I ain't done yet! I want a rematch!

Text: 次は負けねえぞ！

English.Text: You're goin' down next time!

Text: ひいい　もう許してくれ

English.Text: Aah! Please, no more...

Text: だまして……すんません

English.Text: I'm sorry... I'm sorry!

Text: こらしめてやるよ！

English.Text: You're in for it now!

Text: 俺たちをナメやがって！

English.Text: Hah, look down on us, will ya!?

Text: ヒュ～！

English.Text: Woo!

Text: オラオラ　いけよ！

English.Text: Hell yeah! That's what I like to see!

Text: ビビんなよ～！

English.Text: What are ya, chicken!?

Text: もっとやれ！

English.Text: Keep 'em comin'!

Text: ほら　そこだ！

English.Text: Right there─get 'em!

Text: キャ～！

English.Text: Woo!

Text: いけいけ～！

English.Text: Come on, hit 'em! Hit 'em!

Text: ぶっとばせ！

English.Text: Make 'em feel it!

Text: キレがないよ！

English.Text: Give 'em hell!

Text: ああ～……

English.Text: Ugh...

Text: おお～！

English.Text: Woohoo!

Text: ヒュ～！

English.Text: Woo!

Text:
はあ　ぜんぜん酔えねえよ
マスター　この酒ほとんど水だろ

English.Text: Hey...barkeep. You sure this shit's booze? 'Cause it tastes more like chocobo piss to me.

Text:
文句があるなら出てけよ
それで　二度と店には来るな

English.Text: Don't like what I serve? Leave. And be sure to let the door hit your ass on your way out.

Text:
なあ　キッツイのくれよ
火をつけたら燃えあがるようなヤツをよ

English.Text: Listen, man. I'm just asking for somethin' harder, y'know? Somethin' that'll knock my socks off!

Text:
明日からの行き先をなくしたくなけりゃ
出された酒を　おとなしく飲んでな

English.Text: I suggest you drink your drink─or you find yourself another bar to patronize. Got me?

Text:
ああ？　見ねえ顔だな
ここじゃ　よそ者は歓迎されねえぞ

English.Text: Huh... Ain't seen you before. Just so you know, outsiders ain't welcome here.

Text:
酒場の殴りあいは
炭坑時代からの恒例行事だ

English.Text: Barroom brawls've been a time-honored tradition since the minin' days.

Text: はは　よそ者は挑戦もできねえよ

English.Text: Haha... Not that outsiders can participate.

Text: マテリア投資の取り立ては順調か？

English.Text: So, how's the investment squeeze comin'?

Text: 楽勝っす

English.Text: Just like you said it would!

Text:
全員とっつかまえて
トラックに詰めこみました

English.Text: We already got 'em all rounded up in the truck. They ain't goin' nowhere.

Text:
いつでもかっさばいて
売り飛ばせます

English.Text: Got room to spare, but we can roll out whenever.

Text:
いいぞ　さらえるだけさらったら
ドロンだ

English.Text: Well, if that's the case, then I say we squeeze in a few more.

Text: ヒヒヒ　楽勝っす！

English.Text: Heh heh heh... You got it, Boss.

Text: ああ　やり直してえなあ

English.Text: Wish I could go back and do it all over again.

Text: どっかに別の世界ないかなあ

English.Text: Try settin' off for a parallel world, maybe...

Text: ほら　おとなしくしな

English.Text: No funny business!

Text: たっぷり　お仕置きしてやるからな！

English.Text: Y'all ain't gonna like what comes next!

Text:
あっ　あんた
バレットの連れの人だよね

English.Text: Oh, y'all the folks who came into town with Barret.

Text: 色々と　すまなかったね

English.Text: Sorry about all...you know.

Text:
バレットが　文句言われても受け止めて
村の子供たちのために頑張ってる姿を見て

English.Text: I know it can't've been easy seein' the way we talked to him, And still you went and helped the youngins...

Text: 俺たち　恥ずかしくなってさ

English.Text: Made us realize how foolish we'd been acting.

Text:
いつまでも　過去にとらわれてるばかりじゃ
なにも変わらない

English.Text:
Thing about the past is, it's gone.
And it ain't comin' back.

Text:
この村を　すこしずつでも
変えなきゃって思ったんだ

English.Text: And what really matters now is Corel's future.

Text:
んで　あたしたちにもできること
考えたんだよ

English.Text: So, we asked ourselves what we might could do to work toward a better one.

Text:
コレルプリズンから来てるグリードたち
あんたも気づいたろ？

English.Text: I'm sure you noticed that some boys from the prison set up shop in town.

Text: 俺たちも　見て見ぬフリしてたんだけどな

English.Text: We turned a blind eye to 'em at first, but...

Text:
あたしたちを食いものにしてるコイツらを
まずこらしめてやろうってね　決めたわけよ

English.Text: No longer. It's high time they learned what happens when folks try to take advantage of us.

Text:
店の中で　きっちりお仕置きしてるから
見てってくれよ

English.Text: You're welcome to watch their "education" in the bar if you want.

Text:
詐欺グループのグリードたちを
捕まえたんだ

English.Text: We caught those hustlers out of Corel Prison.

Text: いまは順番にお仕置き中だよ

English.Text: Folks're linin' up to say hello.

Text: グリードの連中にも　同郷のヤツがいる

English.Text: Some of them came up around here, believe it or not.

Text:
いつか仲良く　昔のコレル村みたいに
暮らせるといいな

English.Text: Maybe one day they'll get their shit together and do right by their kin.

Text:
まあ　すぐには変わらないだろうけどよ
すこしずつやっていくさ

English.Text: Change doesn't happen overnight. Just gotta keep chippin' away at it. Bit by bit.

Text:
ゴールドソーサーの裏方で働ける連中は
ここじゃ超一流の仕事人だよ

English.Text: The lucky people who get to work behind the scenes at the Gold Saucer─now those ones are the top earners.

Text:
まあ　給料は
しぼりとられてるらしいけどね

English.Text: Though they're still squeezed out of damn near every last gil, I hear.

Text:
おれ　ゴールドソーサーの
着ぐるみなんだけど……

English.Text: Wearing that costume all day gets kinda old.

Text: うわ　これ秘密だった！

English.Text: Oh! I mean, uh...

Text: 聞かなかったことにしてくれクポ！

English.Text: I don't work at the Gold Saucer, kupo!

Text: 終わった　またしても遅刻

English.Text: Shit... Late again. I'm in for it now.

Text: またリーダーに嫌味言われる

English.Text: My boss is gonna rake me over the coals.

Text:
減給かな
まさか　クビはないよな？

English.Text: Wait, he wouldn't fire me, would he? A pay cut, sure, but...

Text:
はあ　やっぱり
サボっちゃおうかな～

English.Text: Maybe I oughta skip work today.

Text:
踊りながら掃除するの
キツいのよね

English.Text: Having to dance while I clean is brutal.

Text: プロペラよ～し　ロープよ～し！

English.Text: Propeller good, ropes good! All clear!

Text:
ゴールドソーサー行きロープウェイ
これに乗れば　いつでも黄金の楽園行き

English.Text: Step right up! This ropeway is your one-way ticket to a golden paradise!

Text:
たまに頭のネジがはずれる
オレの整備だ　絶対安全だぜ！

English.Text: Safe and reliable! My head's got more loose screws than this thing!

Text:
今日で何連勤？
体調も悪いし　休んじゃえば？

English.Text: How long's it been since you had a day off? You need to rest. You're practically falling apart!

Text:
僕のショーを楽しみにくる
お客様のために　がんばらなきゃ！

English.Text: But what about all the people who look forward to my show? I can't let them down.

Text:
お客さんは休みで遊びに来てるのに
ゴールドソーサーで働く人は休めない

English.Text: I get that, but we work our asses off for weeks on end, entertaining people who can actually afford to take a vacation...

Text:
そんなんで
おもてなしできるのかな？

English.Text: and we're left with what? A crummy paycheck and aching feet?

Text:
いいんだよ　夢の仕事なんだ
休みナシでも失いたくない

English.Text: But this is my dream job. I'd never forgive myself if I lost it just 'cause I wanted a break.

Text:
パパ　帰ってこなかったね
また『ざんぎょう』？

English.Text: Daddy's not back yet. Is he, um, doing overtime again?

Text: きっとそうね

English.Text: I'm sure he is.

Text:
パパが着てるモーグリは
人気者だから　忙しいのね

English.Text: You know how much everyone up there loves Daddy's moogle costume!

Text: うん　きっとそう

English.Text: He'll be back any minute.

Text: うんうん　今日も順調だな

English.Text: Glad to see everything's running smoothly today.

Text:
次の便までに　ゴールドソーサーで
調達してもらったもんを配る準備だ

English.Text: Need to get the goods from the Gold Saucer ready by the time the next gondola comes round, though.

Text:
イイぞ……
ああ　気持ちイイ……

English.Text: Oh, if only I could stay like this forever. Forever and ever...

Text:
こんなに楽しくて
給料も……イイ

English.Text: The pay is so good...and the work is even better.

Text:
これぞ天職……
ああ　やめられない～

English.Text: I was born for this job. Truly, I was! And nothing but death will ever keep me from it.

Text: ふう～　ほお～……
邪念　退散！

English.Text: Begone, wickedness! Begone!

Text: むうう　喝ッ！

English.Text: Hrrn... Hrah!

Text: わしと戦うには　鍛錬が足りんの

English.Text: You require more training if you hope to face me.

Text: 瞑想中だ　邪魔するでない

English.Text: Can't you see I'm meditating?

Text:
おお　ようやく辿り着いたか
おぬしが来るのを待っておったぞ

English.Text: So, you have begun to fulfill your potential. Long have I awaited this day.

Text: ほほほ　そう警戒せんでもよい

English.Text: Hahah... At ease, young SOLDIER.

Text:
この小さな村に　おぬしは目立ちすぎる
どこにおっても感じ取れるわい

English.Text: I took your measure the moment you set foot in this town. Hard not to, given your presence.

Text:
わしは『百目のナバラ』
瞑想により手に入れた　百の心眼

English.Text: I am Navalan of the thousand eyes. Years of meditation have granted me sight beyond sight.

Text:
どれだけ隠れても無駄なこと
おぬしのことは　すべてお見通しよ

English.Text: It is this clarity which shows me all─even that which some wish to keep hidden.

Text:
その複雑で力強いオーラ
うむ　相手にとって不足なし！

English.Text: You exude a powerful yet troubled aura... Indeed, it makes you the perfect opponent.

Text: さあ　心して挑んでくるがよい

English.Text: Come─and don't you dare hold anything back!

Text: ほほほ　丸裸にされるのが怖いのかの？

English.Text: Hahaha! Afraid I may expose the darkness within?

Text: どれ　わしの心眼で丸裸にしてやろう

English.Text: Oh? Undaunted by the clarity of my second sight?

Text: おぬしの心を　のぞいてみようかの

English.Text: Then let me gaze into the depths of your soul.

Text:
クイーンズ・ブラッドに邪悪な気配が漂っている
気をつけたほうがいいぞ

English.Text: I sense a great evil festering within the cards of this game. Best keep at least one eye open.

Text:
私の名前は　リドラル・バモン
クイーンズ・ブラッドの生みの親だ

English.Text: My name is Lidrehl Balmon...and I am the creator of the game Queen's Blood.

Text: つまり　すべては私の責任だ

English.Text:
Which means that...
this nightmare is of my own making.

Text: まさか　こんなことになるとは

English.Text: I didn't know. How could I?

Text: 聞こえたか？　もう時間がない

English.Text: You hear her too? Time's running out.

Text: 彼女が呼んでいる　行かなければ

English.Text: She's calling me... Commanding me...

Text: 私は　囚われている

English.Text: She's made me her prisoner.

Text: 呪いのカードだ　終わりは近い

English.Text: Her accursed card my shackle. The end is nigh.

Text: いや　これは始まりなのか？

English.Text: Or perhaps...this is only the beginning.

Text: 『黒紅の女王』が――

English.Text: The Shadowblood Queen is...

Text:
もしや　おぬし
リドラルの幻覚を目にしたのか？

English.Text:
Let me guess.
You have dreamt the dream of Lidrehl Balmon too.

Text: なにか　知っているのか？

English.Text: Whadda you know about it?

Text:
最近　バウターたちの間で
奇妙な白昼夢を見たという噂が広がっておる

English.Text: Only rumors and hearsay: that players of particular skill have experienced strange visions of late.

Text:
なんでも　クイーンズ・ブラッドを生み出した
リドラルの亡霊が話しかけてくるとか

English.Text: Visions in which one is visited by the ghost of the game's creator, who speaks of portentous events.

Text: それだけでないぞ

English.Text: To add another wrinkle...

Text:
すこしまえから　名だたるバウターたちが
次々と変死しておってな

English.Text: some of the world's very best have recently met with unnaturally violent deaths.

Text: リドラルの呪いだという者もおる

English.Text: People are calling this the Curse of Lidrehl.

Text:
わしの心眼をもってしても見極められぬ
邪悪ななにかが動き始めておる

English.Text: Not even my third eye can discern the true cause, though it is clearly something sinister.

Text:
おぬし　このまま最強のバウターを目指すなら
くれぐれも注意することだ

English.Text: If you wish to continue on the path of the cards, then remain vigilant, or it may lead to your undoing.

Text:
目に見えるものにとらわれてはいかん
心の目で見るのだ

English.Text: To see the world as it truly is, rely not on your eyes, but your heart.

Text: もっと　心眼を鍛えることだな

English.Text: Your second sight could still use some work.

Text: わしと引き分けるとは　たいしたものだ

English.Text: Managing a tie against me is no small feat.

Text: おぬし　また腕を上げたな

English.Text: I see you're continuing to improve.

Text: わしが　丸裸にされてしまったな

English.Text: It seems I have been well and truly bested.
